license: Catalog annotations and these files: MIT. Linked resources, papers, data and weights keep their own terms.
description: Curated research papers and surveys, with authors, recorded publication dates, arXiv versions and citation files.

items.name: End-to-End Goal-Driven Web Navigation
items.summary: Introduces WebNav for converting websites into goal-directed hyperlink navigation tasks and WikiNav for evaluating language-conditioned navigation and question answering on Wikipedia.

items.name: Reinforcement Learning on Web Interfaces Using Workflow-Guided Exploration
items.summary: Uses workflows extracted from demonstrations to constrain reinforcement-learning exploration for interactive web tasks.

items.name: Mapping Natural Language Commands to Web Elements
items.summary: Defines language grounding on webpages as choosing the UI element targeted by a natural-language command. A collection of more than 50,000 commands and three baseline models study functional references, relationships between elements, and visual position cues.

items.name: Learning to Navigate the Web
items.summary: Introduces guided RL for QWeb, using a curriculum of smaller instructions and generated tasks to train an agent that follows instructions and fills forms on web pages.

items.name: A Systematic Literature Review of Automated Techniques for Functional GUI Testing of Mobile Applications
items.summary: Surveys automated functional GUI testing techniques for mobile apps, comparing the effectiveness, efficiency and practicality of approaches reported in 25 studies.

items.name: DOM-Q-NET: Grounded RL on Structured Language
items.summary: Introduces DOM-Q-NET, an RL architecture for web navigation that represents HTML as a tree and uses separate Q-function networks for clicking elements and typing text.

items.name: Interactive Task and Concept Learning from Natural Language Instructions and GUI Demonstrations
items.summary: Introduces PUMICE, an agent that learns mobile-app procedures and conditional concepts through natural-language conversation and GUI demonstrations, recursively resolving ambiguous instructions with users.

items.name: Mapping Natural Language Instructions to Mobile UI Action Sequences
items.summary: Introduces PIXELHELP for predicting mobile UI action sequences from instructions, together with action-phrase annotations and synthetic UI action descriptions for training. Separate Transformers extract instruction steps and ground object descriptions using interface content and screen position.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 58th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics

items.name: From Robotic Process Automation to Intelligent Process Automation: Emerging Trends
items.summary: A survey of robotic and intelligent process automation traces the use of machine learning and AI in business workflows and identifies open research challenges.
items.venue: Lecture Notes in Business Information Processing

items.name: Object Detection for Graphical User Interface: Old Fashioned or Deep Learning or a Combination?
items.summary: Compares seven traditional and learned GUI element detectors on more than 50,000 interface images. The analysis motivates a coarse-to-fine non-text detector combined with a learned text detector to address GUI-specific localization requirements.

items.name: Widget Captioning: Generating Natural Language Description for Mobile User Interface Elements
items.summary: Introduces crowdsourced descriptions of mobile UI elements and studies multimodal models that generate useful widget captions.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 2020 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP)

items.name: ActionBert: Leveraging User Actions for Semantic Understanding of User Interfaces
items.summary: Pretrains ActionBert on user interaction traces to combine visual, linguistic, and UI-structure features. It evaluates the resulting UI representations on tasks including icon classification and description-based component retrieval.

items.name: Screen Recognition: Creating Accessibility Metadata for Mobile Applications from Pixels
items.summary: Infers UI elements and accessibility metadata from mobile screenshots to support screen-reader interaction with iOS applications.

items.name: WebSRC: A Dataset for Web-Based Structural Reading Comprehension
items.summary: Introduces question answering over webpage text and structure, with aligned HTML, screenshots, and metadata for structural reading comprehension.

items.name: Grounding Open-Domain Instructions to Automate Web Support Tasks
items.summary: Introduces RUSS, which translates support instructions into a domain-specific language and grounds them in actionable web elements.

items.name: Mobile App Tasks with Iterative Feedback (MoTIF): Addressing Task Feasibility in Interactive Visual Environments
items.summary: Introduces MoTIF, a dataset of natural-language requests for interactive mobile apps, including infeasible requests and follow-up questions for studying task feasibility.

items.name: Understanding Mobile GUI: from Pixel-Words to Screen-Sentences
items.summary: Models mobile screens as atomic text and graphic components whose relationships are learned by a Screen Transformer. The work introduces RICO-PW annotations and evaluates metadata-free screen understanding on relation, clickability, retrieval, and app-classification tasks.

items.name: AndroidEnv: A Reinforcement Learning Platform for Android
items.summary: Presents an Android environment for training and evaluating reinforcement-learning agents through touchscreen interaction.

items.name: AppBuddy: Learning to Accomplish Tasks in Mobile Apps via Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Introduces AppBuddy, an RL training platform and task suite for mobile apps where agents use on-screen element states and tap or type to complete multi-step tasks.

items.name: UIBert: Learning Generic Multimodal Representations for UI Understanding
items.summary: Learns shared image, text, and structural UI representations through self-supervised tasks based on relationships among interface components.

items.name: Screen2Words: Automatic Mobile UI Summarization with Multimodal Learning
items.summary: Studies mobile-screen summarization using visual, textual, and structural UI information, with a dataset of human-written descriptions.

items.name: VUT: Versatile UI Transformer for Multi-Modal Multi-Task User Interface Modeling
items.summary: The Versatile UI Transformer jointly models interface screenshots, structure, and language for five UI tasks. Its encoder supports element detection when structural metadata is absent, while an autoregressive component handles UI question answering and command grounding.

items.name: WebGPT: Browser-assisted question-answering with human feedback
items.summary: Trains a question-answering model to search and navigate a text-based web browser, collect references and improve long-form answers using demonstrations and human feedback.

items.name: Learning to Denoise Raw Mobile UI Layouts for Improving Datasets at Scale
items.summary: Introduces CLAY, a pipeline that repairs noisy mobile UI layouts by removing nodes without valid visual counterparts and assigning semantic element types, supported by human-annotated layouts for evaluation.

items.name: A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Language Navigation with Unknown Command Feasibility
items.summary: Introduces MoTIF mobile-app interactions with feasible and infeasible commands, feasibility explanations, and follow-up questions for ambiguous requests.

items.name: A data-driven approach for learning to control computers
items.summary: Combines reinforcement learning with behavioral priors from human interactions to learn computer control through keyboard and mouse actions.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 39th International Conference on Machine Learning

items.name: META-GUI: Towards Multi-modal Conversational Agents on Mobile GUI
items.summary: Introduces GUI-based task-oriented dialogue and a dataset pairing mobile-interface operations with conversational responses.

items.name: WebShop: Towards Scalable Real-World Web Interaction with Grounded Language Agents
items.summary: Provides a simulated shopping environment where language agents search, configure, and select products from natural-language requirements.

items.name: CORNET: Learning Table Formatting Rules By Example
items.summary: Introduces CORNET, a system that learns spreadsheet conditional-formatting rules from cells formatted by users, using symbolic rule enumeration and a neural ranker.

items.name: ScreenQA: Large-Scale Question-Answer Pairs over Mobile App Screenshots
items.summary: Introduces screenshot question answering over mobile interfaces, linking answers to screen content and bounding boxes.

items.name: Enabling Conversational Interaction with Mobile UI using Large Language Models
items.summary: Studies few-shot prompting of a single language model for four mobile-UI interaction tasks, aiming to support conversational interface use without a separate trained model for each task.

items.name: Spotlight: Mobile UI Understanding using Vision-Language Models with a Focus
items.summary: Introduces Spotlight, a vision-language model conditioned on a UI screenshot and a selected region of interest. It evaluates screenshot-based mobile UI understanding and explores multitask learning and few-shot prompting.

items.name: MUG: Interactive Multimodal Grounding on User Interfaces
items.summary: Studies iterative UI grounding in which users refine or correct an agent's interpretation over multiple conversational turns.

items.name: Towards Better Semantic Understanding of Mobile Interfaces
items.summary: Augments RICO screens and view hierarchies with human labels for icon shape and meaning and for links between UI elements and text labels. It compares image-only and multimodal models on semantic understanding of previously unseen apps.

items.name: Pix2Struct: Screenshot Parsing as Pretraining for Visual Language Understanding
items.summary: Pix2Struct pretrains an image-to-text model by reconstructing simplified HTML from masked webpage screenshots. Its variable-resolution visual representation is evaluated across several domains, including user-interface understanding.

items.name: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
items.summary: Introduces ReAct, a method that interleaves reasoning traces and actions for language-model agents; WebShop is one of its interactive decision-making evaluations.

items.name: Understanding HTML with Large Language Models
items.summary: Studies language models for HTML element classification, page description and autonomous web navigation. Fine-tuned models are evaluated on MiniWoB, and a distilled, automatically labeled CommonCrawl HTML corpus supports the training approach.

items.name: UGIF: UI Grounded Instruction Following
items.summary: Introduces multilingual smartphone instruction-following data and a pipeline that retrieves help instructions and maps them to UI actions.
items.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: NAACL 2024

items.name: Fill in the Blank: Context-aware Automated Text Input Generation for Mobile GUI Testing
items.summary: Introduces QTypist, an LLM-based method that generates text inputs from mobile GUI context and integrates with automated testing tools to help them reach further app pages.

items.name: Lexi: Self-Supervised Learning of the UI Language
items.summary: Introduces Lexi and UICaption to learn UI image-text representations from descriptions of interface functionality. Evaluation covers UI action entailment, instruction-based retrieval, referring-expression grounding, and UI entity recognition.

items.name: WebUI: A Dataset for Enhancing Visual UI Understanding with Web Semantics
items.summary: Collects rendered webpages and structural metadata for visual UI modeling, studying how web semantics transfer to interface-understanding tasks.

items.name: FLAME: A small language model for spreadsheet formulas
items.summary: Introduces FLAME, a model trained on Excel formulas for spreadsheet formula repair, completion and retrieval, supporting formula authoring in spreadsheet software.

items.name: Language Models can Solve Computer Tasks
items.summary: Introduces recursive criticism and improvement prompting for language-model agents performing computer tasks, evaluated on MiniWoB++ with a small number of demonstrations per task.

items.name: DroidBot-GPT: GPT-powered UI Automation for Android
items.summary: Transforms Android UI states and available actions into language prompts for an LLM to choose and execute task steps.

items.name: Mobile-Env: Building Qualified Evaluation Benchmarks for LLM-GUI Interaction
items.summary: Provides an Android benchmark toolkit with controlled environments, intermediate feedback, and task sets for reproducible GUI-agent evaluation.

items.name: Mobile User Interface Element Detection Via Adaptively Prompt Tuning
items.summary: Introduces MUI-zh and APT for detecting mobile UI elements, combining visual features with OCR descriptions to adjust category prompts in CLIP-based detectors.

items.name: Multimodal Web Navigation with Instruction-Finetuned Foundation Models
items.summary: Trains WebGUM offline from demonstrations by jointly tuning an instruction-following language model and a vision encoder over webpage screenshots and HTML. The agent predicts browser actions and is evaluated on MiniWoB, WebShop, and Mind2Web.
items.venue: International Conference on Learning Representations

items.name: Hierarchical Prompting Assists Large Language Model on Web Navigation
items.summary: Separates web navigation prompting into a SUMMARIZER that extracts action-relevant observations and an ACTOR that chooses the next action from the condensed context.

items.name: AdaPlanner: Adaptive Planning from Feedback with Language Models
items.summary: Introduces AdaPlanner, which revises code-structured plans in response to environmental feedback and reuses successful plans as exemplars. Experiments include MiniWoB++ web tasks alongside ALFWorld.

items.name: SheetCopilot: Bringing Software Productivity to the Next Level through Large Language Models
items.summary: Introduces SheetCopilot, an agent that steers spreadsheet software via atomic virtual APIs, along with a 221-task spreadsheet manipulation benchmark.

items.name: From Pixels to UI Actions: Learning to Follow Instructions via Graphical User Interfaces
items.summary: Studies instruction-following agents that observe screenshots and act through a generic mouse-and-keyboard action space, evaluating pixel-based pretraining for GUI tasks on MiniWoB++.
items.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

items.name: Responsible Task Automation: Empowering Large Language Models as Responsible Task Automators
items.summary: Presents ResponsibleTA, a coordinator-executor framework that checks command feasibility and task completion while using local memory for privacy-related controls. The paper compares prompted and learned implementations and evaluates them on UI task automation.

items.name: Prompting Is All You Need: Automated Android Bug Replay with Large Language Models
items.summary: Introduces AdbGPT, a prompting-based approach that uses LLMs to replay app bugs from written reports, applying few-shot examples and reasoning without model training.

items.name: Mind2Web: Towards a Generalist Agent for the Web
items.summary: Introduces a web-task dataset spanning diverse websites and evaluates generalization to unseen sites and domains.

items.name: Synapse: Trajectory-as-Exemplar Prompting with Memory for Computer Control
items.summary: Synapse filters task-irrelevant page state and places complete abstracted state-action trajectories into the prompt. An embedding-based exemplar memory retrieves relevant demonstrations for new tasks, evaluated on MiniWoB++ and Mind2Web.

items.name: Android in the Wild: A Large-Scale Dataset for Android Device Control
items.summary: Collects Android interaction demonstrations with screens, actions, and instructions across device and platform variations for robustness evaluation.
items.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

items.name: A Real-World WebAgent with Planning, Long Context Understanding, and Program Synthesis
items.summary: Combines task decomposition, HTML summarization, and generated Python programs to carry out instructions on websites.

items.name: WebArena: A Realistic Web Environment for Building Autonomous Agents
items.summary: Introduces reproducible web environments with task-completion checks for evaluating autonomous web agents.

items.name: AgentBench: Evaluating LLMs as Agents
items.summary: Evaluates language agents across eight interactive environments and analyzes failures in reasoning, decisions, and instruction following.

items.name: Unveiling the Tricks: Automated Detection of Dark Patterns in Mobile Applications
items.summary: Introduces UIGuard, a system that examines mobile UI visuals and text to detect dark patterns, together with a labeled dataset of benign and malicious interfaces.

items.name: AutoDroid: LLM-powered Task Automation in Android
items.summary: Combines language-model reasoning with app analysis, UI representations, and exploration-derived memory for Android task automation.

items.name: LASER: LLM Agent with State-Space Exploration for Web Navigation
items.summary: LASER represents web navigation as exploration over a defined set of states, allowing an agent to revisit earlier states after mistakes. The study evaluates this backtracking approach on WebShop and Amazon tasks.

items.name: You Only Look at Screens: Multimodal Chain-of-Action Agents
items.summary: Introduces Auto-GUI, a screenshot-based agent using previous actions and future action plans to guide device interaction.
items.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2024

items.name: AXNav: Replaying Accessibility Tests from Natural Language
items.summary: Introduces an LLM and pixel-based UI system that executes natural-language accessibility tests, records navigable videos and flags potential interface issues.

items.name: SteP: Stacked LLM Policies for Web Actions
items.summary: SteP dynamically composes specialized web-action policies through a stack that records the active chain of policy calls. It studies this control structure across WebArena, MiniWoB++, and CRM workflows.

items.name: Reinforced UI Instruction Grounding: Towards a Generic UI Task Automation API
items.summary: Trains a screenshot-based instruction-grounding model to predict target coordinates, using reinforcement learning to improve spatial decoding.

items.name: ILuvUI: Instruction-tuned LangUage-Vision modeling of UIs from Machine Conversations
items.summary: ILuvUI generates 335,000 conversational training examples paired with UI screenshots, covering questions, descriptions, and plans. The resulting vision-language model is assessed on element detection, response quality, and examples of multi-step UI navigation.

items.name: UReader: Universal OCR-free Visually-situated Language Understanding with Multimodal Large Language Model
items.summary: Introduces UReader, which combines unified instruction tuning, auxiliary text-reading tasks and shape-adaptive image crops for OCR-free visual language understanding. Its evaluation includes webpage screenshots alongside documents, tables, charts and natural images.

items.name: CrashTranslator: Automatically Reproducing Mobile Application Crashes Directly from Stack Trace
items.summary: Introduces CrashTranslator, which predicts GUI exploration steps from stack traces with an LLM and uses RL-guided search to reproduce crashes in Android apps.

items.name: A Zero-Shot Language Agent for Computer Control with Structured Reflection
items.summary: Studies a zero-shot computer-control agent that plans executable actions and organizes its own reflections after mistakes. MiniWoB++ experiments examine learning to complete tasks without supplied expert trajectories.

items.name: OpenAgents: An Open Platform for Language Agents in the Wild
items.summary: OpenAgents hosts three language agents, for data analysis, API plugins and autonomous web browsing, behind a web interface for non-expert users, with local deployment for developers.

items.name: Set-of-Mark Prompting Unleashes Extraordinary Visual Grounding in GPT-4V
items.summary: Overlays labeled image regions to help multimodal models refer to and reason about visual targets; a general visual-prompting method relevant to GUI grounding.

items.name: Vision-Based Mobile App GUI Testing: A Survey
items.summary: Surveys vision-based mobile app GUI testing across test generation, record-and-replay and testing frameworks, drawing on 271 papers including 92 vision-based studies.

items.name: InstructExcel: A Benchmark for Natural Language Instruction in Excel
items.summary: Introduces InstructExcel, a benchmark for generating Excel OfficeScripts from natural-language requests, built using scripts recorded from user actions and a collection of existing spreadsheets.

items.name: Make LLM a Testing Expert: Bringing Human-like Interaction to Mobile GUI Testing via Functionality-aware Decisions
items.summary: Introduces GPTDroid for mobile GUI testing: it feeds app page information to an LLM, runs generated test scripts and uses feedback and memory to guide further exploration.

items.name: WebWISE: Web Interface Control and Sequential Exploration with Large Language Models
items.summary: WebWISE filters DOM elements into observations and generates short programs for click, scroll, and text-entry steps. It evaluates in-context learning from either one supplied example or an example collected during a successful zero-shot MiniWoB++ trial.

items.name: AllTogether: Investigating the Efficacy of Spliced Prompt for Web Navigation using Large Language Models
items.summary: AllTogether standardizes prompts for HTML-based web navigation and compares prompting with instruction fine-tuning. Its analysis examines how HTML context, interaction history, and current environmental feedback affect task execution.

items.name: PPTC Benchmark: Evaluating Large Language Models for PowerPoint Task Completion
items.summary: Evaluates multi-turn PowerPoint creation and editing by scoring the resulting presentation files.

items.name: GPT-4V in Wonderland: Large Multimodal Models for Zero-Shot Smartphone GUI Navigation
items.summary: Studies MM-Navigator, a multimodal agent that interprets smartphone screenshots and predicts localized actions without task-specific training.

items.name: Autonomous Large Language Model Agents Enabling Intent-Driven Mobile GUI Testing
items.summary: DroidAgent uses language models and memory to set and execute GUI test goals in Android apps; an evaluation covers 15 apps from the Themis benchmark.
items.venue: 2024 IEEE Conference on Software Testing, Verification and Validation (ICST)

items.name: ProAgent: From Robotic Process Automation to Agentic Process Automation
items.summary: Introduces ProAgent, an LLM-based agent that builds automation workflows from human instructions and coordinates specialized agents during workflow execution.

items.name: GAIA: a benchmark for General AI Assistants
items.summary: Introduces questions that test assistant reasoning, multimodal understanding, browsing, and tool use beyond screen-action execution alone.

items.name: Exposing Limitations of Language Model Agents in Sequential-Task Compositions on the Web
items.summary: CompWoB adds 50 composed web-automation tasks to study generalization from simpler interactions. The paper compares prompted and fine-tuned agents, balances task training data, and probes sensitivity to changes in instruction order.

items.name: Explore, Select, Derive, and Recall: Augmenting LLM with Human-like Memory for Mobile Task Automation
items.summary: Introduces MobileGPT, which organizes mobile-app experience into reusable subtasks using an explore, select, derive, and recall cycle. Its memory supports learning task procedures and adapting them to new contexts.

items.name: Intelligent Virtual Assistants with LLM-based Process Automation
items.summary: Presents LLMPA, a mobile process-automation architecture that decomposes requests, identifies interface elements, predicts actions and checks errors. Demonstrations evaluate multistep operations in Alipay.

items.name: CogAgent: A Visual Language Model for GUI Agents
items.summary: Introduces a visual-language model with low- and high-resolution image encoders for screenshot understanding and GUI navigation.
items.venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition

items.name: UINav: A Practical Approach to Train On-Device Automation Agents
items.summary: Introduces UINav, a demonstration-based method for training mobile UI automation agents, with a referee model for failure feedback and automatic augmentation of examples.

items.name: VisionTasker: Mobile Task Automation Using Vision Based UI Understanding and LLM Task Planning
items.summary: VisionTasker converts screenshots into textual UI interpretations and presents one interface at a time to an LLM planner for action selection. It evaluates visual representations and execution of 147 tasks on an Android smartphone, including integration with programming by demonstration.

items.name: ASSISTGUI: Task-Oriented Desktop Graphical User Interface Automation
items.summary: Introduces Windows application tasks and an actor-critic agent framework for mouse-and-keyboard automation of desktop workflows.

items.name: AppAgent: Multimodal Agents as Smartphone Users
items.summary: Builds app knowledge through exploration or human demonstrations and uses it to guide multimodal smartphone interactions.

items.name: WebVLN: Vision-and-Language Navigation on Websites
items.summary: WebVLN trains website navigation from question-based instructions using both rendered visual information and underlying HTML. It introduces WebVLN-v1 and a website-aware navigation network to study this digital variant of vision-and-language navigation.

items.name: AutoTask: Executing Arbitrary Voice Commands by Exploring and Learning from Mobile GUI
items.summary: Executes voice-requested mobile tasks through GUI exploration, backtracking, and accumulated interaction experience.

items.name: GPT-4V(ision) is a Generalist Web Agent, if Grounded
items.summary: Introduces SeeAct and live-website evaluation, examining how visual planning and element grounding affect web-agent task completion.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning

items.name: MobileAgent: enhancing mobile control via human-machine interaction and SOP integration
items.summary: Combines operating-procedure context with user interaction to guide mobile task automation and handle personalized or sensitive requests.

items.name: SeeClick: Harnessing GUI Grounding for Advanced Visual GUI Agents
items.summary: Trains a screenshot-driven GUI agent with grounding pretraining and introduces ScreenSpot for evaluating interface target localization.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 62nd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)

items.name: AgentBoard: An Analytical Evaluation Board of Multi-turn LLM Agents
items.summary: Introduces AgentBoard, a multiturn agent evaluation framework with intermediate progress metrics and analysis tools. Its broader task suite includes WebShop and WebArena interactions with stepwise progress measurements.

items.name: VisualWebArena: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Realistic Visual Web Tasks
items.summary: Introduces visually grounded website tasks for evaluating multimodal agents that must interpret both images and text.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 62nd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)

items.name: WebVoyager: Building an End-to-End Web Agent with Large Multimodal Models
items.summary: Combines multimodal web interaction with a real-website task collection and an automated evaluation protocol.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 62nd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)

items.name: GPTVoiceTasker: Advancing Multi-step Mobile Task Efficiency Through Dynamic Interface Exploration and Learning
items.summary: Introduces GPTVoiceTasker, a mobile assistant that interprets user commands, executes device interactions, and learns from prior commands to streamline later task execution. The work includes a user study of task efficiency.

items.name: Mobile-Agent: Autonomous Multi-Modal Mobile Device Agent with Visual Perception
items.summary: Uses visual perception tools and task decomposition to operate mobile applications without relying on app interface metadata.

items.name: Dual-View Visual Contextualization for Web Navigation
items.summary: Uses screenshot geometry and visual content to enrich HTML element representations for web navigation. Nearby elements contribute textual and visual context, with evaluation on cross-task, cross-website, and cross-domain Mind2Web splits.

items.name: ScreenAI: A Vision-Language Model for UI and Infographics Understanding
items.summary: Introduces ScreenAI and screen-annotation training that supports UI question answering, navigation, and summarization data generation.

items.name: UEyes: An Eye-Tracking Dataset across User Interface Types
items.summary: Introduces UEyes, an eye-tracking dataset of webpage, desktop, mobile, and poster interfaces, and analyzes how people view these different UI types.

items.name: WebLINX: Real-World Website Navigation with Multi-Turn Dialogue
items.summary: Collects expert demonstrations of conversational web navigation and studies retrieval-based element selection for processing large pages.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning

items.name: Understanding the Weakness of Large Language Model Agents within a Complex Android Environment
items.summary: Introduces AndroidArena and analyzes agent limitations in cross-application tasks, user constraints, exploration, and reflection.

items.name: OS-Copilot: Towards Generalist Computer Agents with Self-Improvement
items.summary: Provides an operating-system agent framework connecting applications, files, terminals, and web tools, with accumulated skills for subsequent tasks.

items.name: UFO: A UI-Focused Agent for Windows OS Interaction
items.summary: UFO uses two agents to inspect Windows application interfaces and their control metadata, then grounds and executes user requests within and across applications. The study evaluates this UI-focused architecture on nine Windows applications.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 2025 Conference of the Nations of the Americas Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics: Human Language Technologies (Volume 1: Long Papers)

items.name: ScreenAgent: A Vision Language Model-driven Computer Control Agent
items.summary: Combines a screenshot-and-action dataset with a planning, acting, and reflecting loop for computer control through mouse and keyboard actions.

items.name: A Trembling House of Cards? Mapping Adversarial Attacks against Language Agents
items.summary: Presents a conceptual perception–reasoning–action framework and 12 potential attack scenarios for language agents, including hypothetical web-navigation attacks.

items.name: Watch Out for Your Agents! Investigating Backdoor Threats to LLM-Based Agents
items.summary: Studies backdoor attacks on LLM agents, including triggers in user queries or intermediate observations, with web shopping among the evaluated agent tasks.

items.name: CoCo-Agent: A Comprehensive Cognitive MLLM Agent for Smartphone GUI Automation
items.summary: Combines screenshots, layout information, and action history with a factored action predictor for smartphone automation.
items.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2024

items.name: Improving Language Understanding from Screenshots
items.summary: Studies language understanding from text-rendered screenshots using joint image-patch and text prediction; a perception foundation relevant to screen-reading models.

items.name: On the Multi-turn Instruction Following for Conversational Web Agents
items.summary: MT-Mind2Web evaluates web navigation through sequences of conversational user instructions. Self-MAP combines memory-augmented planning with reflection to preserve context and dependencies across those interaction turns.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 62nd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)

items.name: WIPI: A New Web Threat for LLM-Driven Web Agents
items.summary: Studies WIPI, a black-box indirect-instruction threat in which webpage content redirects LLM-driven web agents. Evaluation spans plugin-based agents, Web GPTs, and open-source web-agent implementations.

items.name: OmniACT: A Dataset and Benchmark for Enabling Multimodal Generalist Autonomous Agents for Desktop and Web
items.summary: Introduces a dataset and benchmark for generating executable task scripts from screenshots and visually grounded desktop or web instructions.

items.name: Android in the Zoo: Chain-of-Action-Thought for GUI Agents
items.summary: Introduces Chain-of-Action-Thought and Android-In-The-Zoo annotations that connect prior actions, screen observations, intended actions, and expected outcomes.
items.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2024

items.name: Cradle: Empowering Foundation Agents Towards General Computer Control
items.summary: Uses screenshot observations, planning modules, and generated low-level keyboard and mouse control for general computer interaction.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning

items.name: SheetAgent: Towards A Generalist Agent for Spreadsheet Reasoning and Manipulation via Large Language Models
items.summary: Introduces SheetRM, a benchmark of long-horizon spreadsheet tasks, and SheetAgent, an LLM agent that plans, retrieves information and reflects while manipulating spreadsheets.

items.name: PPTC-R benchmark: Towards Evaluating the Robustness of Large Language Models for PowerPoint Task Completion
items.summary: Benchmarks robustness of API-based PowerPoint completion under sentence-level, semantic, and multilingual instruction perturbations and changes to the available API set.

items.name: UI Semantic Group Detection: Grouping UI Elements with Similar Semantics in Mobile Graphical User Interface
items.summary: UISCGD detects semantic groups of adjacent text and non-text UI elements. It learns from Android and iOS screenshots to support interface retrieval, UI-to-code structure and screen-reader accessibility.

items.name: WorkArena: How Capable Are Web Agents at Solving Common Knowledge Work Tasks?
items.summary: Introduces enterprise web tasks on ServiceNow and BrowserGym interfaces for evaluating browser-based agents.

items.name: AutoGuide: Automated Generation and Selection of Context-Aware Guidelines for Large Language Model Agents
items.summary: Introduces AutoGuide, which generates conditional, context-aware guidelines from past agent experience to support decisions in sequential tasks, including web navigation.

items.name: Computer User Interface Understanding. A New Dataset and a Learning Framework
items.summary: Introduces desktop interaction videos and a framework combining synthetic examples with hierarchical contrastive learning for interface classification.

items.name: Tur[k]ingBench: A Challenge Benchmark for Web Agents
items.summary: Evaluates web agents on multimodal annotation tasks adapted from HTML interfaces originally built for crowdsourcing workers.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 2025 Conference of the Nations of the Americas Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics: Human Language Technologies (Volume 1: Long Papers)

items.name: MineDreamer: Learning to Follow Instructions via Chain-of-Imagination for Simulated-World Control
items.summary: Introduces MineDreamer, a Minecraft agent that imagines stages of an instruction and turns them into keyboard-and-mouse actions in a simulated world.

items.name: AgentStudio: A Toolkit for Building General Virtual Agents
items.summary: AgentStudio combines an interactive GUI/API environment with tools for creating tasks, annotating interface elements, and labeling actions in videos. Its online suite and GroundUI, IDMBench, and CriticBench datasets examine interaction, grounding, learning from video, and success detection.

items.name: Draw-and-Understand: Leveraging Visual Prompts to Enable MLLMs to Comprehend What You Want
items.summary: Introduces Draw-and-Understand and MDVP-Bench for understanding visual prompts such as points and boxes; its multi-domain data includes mobile and web screenshots.

items.name: ReALM: Reference Resolution As Language Modeling
items.summary: Frames conversational and on-screen reference resolution as language modeling, allowing textual representations of screen entities to support user-reference interpretation. Evaluation separately examines on-screen references against an existing resolver and language-model baselines.

items.name: Prompt2Task: Automating UI Tasks on Smartphones from Textual Prompts
items.summary: Prompt2Task converts textual goals or procedures into smartphone UI automation using agents for intent interpretation, external-information handling, and execution. User feedback and accumulated task knowledge support subsequent task generation and operation.

items.name: AutoWebGLM: A Large Language Model-based Web Navigating Agent
items.summary: Builds a web agent through simplified HTML observations, human-and-AI browsing data, curriculum training, and reinforcement-learning refinement.

items.name: Ferret-UI: Grounded Mobile UI Understanding with Multimodal LLMs
items.summary: Adapts multimodal modeling to mobile interfaces through detailed screen crops, region annotations, and UI reasoning tasks.

items.name: WILBUR: Adaptive In-Context Learning for Robust and Accurate Web Agents
items.summary: WILBUR learns to rank prior task demonstrations for a web agent’s prompt and synthesizes instructions from past runs. A generated task curriculum and a backtracking mechanism support adaptation and recovery, evaluated on WebVoyager.

items.name: VisualWebBench: How Far Have Multimodal LLMs Evolved in Web Page Understanding and Grounding?
items.summary: Separately evaluates web-page reading, understanding, and element grounding across tasks drawn from real websites.

items.name: Autonomous Evaluation and Refinement of Digital Agents
items.summary: Compares automatic trajectory evaluators for web navigation and device control against oracle judgments. The resulting feedback is used for agent fine-tuning and inference-time guidance, including experiments on WebArena.

items.name: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments
items.summary: Introduces a real-computer evaluation environment with execution-based checks for tasks spanning desktop applications and operating-system state.
items.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

items.name: Training a Vision Language Model as Smartphone Assistant
items.summary: Trains a smartphone assistant from sequences of screenshots paired with earlier actions. The model predicts UI-only interactions such as taps and swipes, with evaluation on Android in the Wild.

items.name: Enhancing Mobile "How-to" Queries with Automated Search Results Verification and Reranking
items.summary: Executes instructions from mobile how-to search results inside a controlled Android environment, then uses the observed success of those instructions to verify and rerank technical-support results.

items.name: Large Language Models for Mobile GUI Text Input Generation: An Empirical Study
items.summary: Studies language-model generation of mobile text inputs, comparing UI representations, execution feedback, and human assistance for app testing.

items.name: MMInA: Benchmarking Multihop Multimodal Internet Agents
items.summary: Evaluates multimodal agents on compositional tasks across changing websites and studies replaying prior trajectories as memory support.
items.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2025

items.name: Scaling Instructable Agents Across Many Simulated Worlds
items.summary: The SIMA project trains agents to follow language instructions in simulated 3D worlds, using images as input and keyboard-and-mouse actions as output.

items.name: Grounded Language Agent for Product Search via Intelligent Web Interactions
items.summary: Introduces GLAINTEL, a Flan-T5-based product-search web agent studied under unsupervised learning, demonstration-based training, and unsupervised domain adaptation. It compares ways to combine demonstrations with reinforcement learning.

items.name: UIClip: A Data-driven Model for Assessing User Interface Design
items.summary: UIClip assesses UI design quality and visual relevance from screenshots and descriptions, using crawled, augmented and human-rated interfaces for training.

items.name: Auto-Formula: Recommend Formulas in Spreadsheets using Contrastive Learning for Table Representations
items.summary: Auto-Formula recommends formulas for target spreadsheet cells by adapting formulas from similar spreadsheets within an organization.

items.name: AutoScraper: A Progressive Understanding Web Agent for Web Scraper Generation
items.summary: Introduces AutoScraper, a two-stage framework that uses HTML structure and similarities across pages to generate scrapers for data collection from websites.

items.name: FlowMind: Automatic Workflow Generation with LLMs
items.summary: FlowMind generates API-based workflows from user requests for process automation and presents workflow descriptions that users can inspect and comment on.

items.name: GUIDE: Graphical User Interface Data for Execution
items.summary: Introduces annotated website task trajectories with screenshots, prior actions, reasoning, and grounded next actions for process automation.

items.name: LlamaTouch: A Faithful and Scalable Testbed for Mobile UI Task Automation
items.summary: LlamaTouch executes mobile tasks on devices and evaluates whether an agent visits manually annotated essential application or system states. Screenshot and hierarchy annotations, combined with exact and fuzzy state matching, support evaluation of 496 tasks across multiple agents.

items.name: Benchmarking Mobile Device Control Agents across Diverse Configurations
items.summary: Introduces B-MoCA, an interactive mobile-control benchmark that varies device settings, layouts, and languages to test generalization.

items.name: MMAC-Copilot: Multi-modal Agent Collaboration Operating Copilot
items.summary: Introduces MMAC-Copilot, which coordinates agents with different expertise to operate PC applications. VIBench evaluates visual interaction with applications that lack usable APIs, spanning office, recreation and game tasks.

items.name: Navigating WebAI: Training Agents to Complete Web Tasks with Large Language Models and Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Combines supervised and reinforcement learning for MiniWoB web tasks and investigates whether agents understand HTML structure or memorize target elements.

items.name: Automating the Enterprise with Foundation Models
items.summary: ECLAIR uses multimodal foundation models to automate enterprise workflows from natural-language descriptions, with initial studies of workflow understanding and completion.

items.name: Unveiling Disparities in Web Task Handling Between Human and Web Agent
items.summary: Compares human think-aloud web-task behavior with web-agent planning, action, and reflection. The analysis highlights differences in updating plans, handling ambiguity, and investigating failures.

items.name: MUD: Towards a Large-Scale and Noise-Filtered UI Dataset for Modern Style UI Modeling
items.summary: MUD combines LLM-guided Android app exploration, noise filtering and human annotation to collect modern UI screenshots. The study evaluates the resulting data for element detection and UI retrieval.

items.name: Latent State Estimation Helps UI Agents to Reason
items.summary: Studies explicit textual estimates of latent UI state, including whether commanded actions occurred and how far a task has progressed. The experiments compare agents that reason with these estimates against agents that omit them across public and internal task benchmarks.

items.name: SmartFlow: Robotic Process Automation using LLMs
items.summary: Presents SmartFlow, which converts visible GUI elements into text for language-model action planning and executes the plan through a scripting engine. A collection of enterprise applications evaluates adaptation to different layouts and tasks.

items.name: AndroidWorld: A Dynamic Benchmarking Environment for Autonomous Agents
items.summary: Introduces parameterized Android tasks with initialization, success checks, and cleanup for reproducible interactive evaluation.
items.venue: International Conference on Learning Representations

items.name: V-Zen: Efficient GUI Understanding and Precise Grounding With A Novel Multimodal LLM
items.summary: Describes V-Zen, a multimodal GUI model with dual-resolution image encoders for grounding and next-action prediction, fine-tuned using GUIDE interface elements and task sequences.

items.name: Large Language Models Can Self-Improve At Web Agent Tasks
items.summary: Examines self-improvement by fine-tuning web agents on three mixtures of model-generated training data. WebArena experiments and trajectory-level evaluation measures study task performance, robustness, and behavior beyond aggregate success rates.

items.name: Mobile-Agent-v2: Mobile Device Operation Assistant with Effective Navigation via Multi-Agent Collaboration
items.summary: Separates mobile planning, decision-making, and reflection, with a memory unit for task progress and relevant content.

items.name: WebSuite: Systematically Evaluating Why Web Agents Fail
items.summary: WebSuite organizes browser operations into an action taxonomy and tests both isolated controls and complete workflows. Its diagnostic tasks attribute failures to specific actions, enabling comparison of text-based and multimodal web agents.

items.name: On the Effects of Data Scale on UI Control Agents
items.summary: Studies how Android task performance changes with demonstration scale and releases AndroidControl with high- and low-level instructions.
items.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

items.name: CAAP: Context-Aware Action Planning Prompting to Solve Computer Tasks with Front-End UI Only
items.summary: CAAP converts screenshots into textual observations and plans keyboard-and-mouse actions using a prompt that examines task context from multiple perspectives. The agent is evaluated on MiniWoB++ and WebShop using only front-end visual observations.

items.name: Tell Me What's Next: Textual Foresight for Generic UI Representations
items.summary: Textual Foresight learns UI representations by describing the future screen expected after an action on the current interface. The OpenApp dataset supports pretraining and downstream evaluation of representations that connect individual elements with whole-screen changes.

items.name: MobileAgentBench: An Efficient and User-Friendly Benchmark for Mobile LLM Agents
items.summary: Introduces a mobile-agent benchmark with tasks across open-source applications, organized by difficulty to reduce manual evaluation effort.

items.name: Practical, Automated Scenario-based Mobile App Testing
items.summary: ScenTest builds scenario-specific event knowledge graphs from crowdsourced test reports containing GUI and action information. It uses the current app state and testing context to generate scenario tests across applications.

items.name: GUIOdyssey: A Comprehensive Dataset for Cross-App GUI Navigation on Mobile Devices
items.summary: Introduces annotated cross-application mobile trajectories and studies history-aware navigation over long task sequences.

items.name: GuardAgent: Safeguard LLM Agents by a Guard Agent via Knowledge-Enabled Reasoning
items.summary: Introduces GuardAgent, which translates safety requests into executable guardrail code using plans and retrieved demonstrations. Mind2Web-SC supplies a web-agent safety-policy evaluation alongside a separate healthcare access-control benchmark.

items.name: VideoGUI: A Benchmark for GUI Automation from Instructional Videos
items.summary: Evaluates GUI automation from instructional videos at separate levels of high-level planning, action narration, and primitive execution.
items.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

items.name: GUI-World: A Video Benchmark and Dataset for Multimodal GUI-oriented Understanding
items.summary: Introduces video-based GUI questions and annotations for studying temporal interface understanding across varied interaction settings.

items.name: GUICourse: From General Vision Language Models to Versatile GUI Agents
items.summary: Introduces GUIEnv, GUIAct, and GUIChat datasets to develop OCR, grounding, component knowledge, and interaction abilities in visual-language models.

items.name: DigiRL: Training In-The-Wild Device-Control Agents with Autonomous Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Combines offline initialization and online reinforcement learning in Android environments, with automated evaluation and curriculum-based sampling.
items.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

items.name: WebCanvas: Benchmarking Web Agents in Online Environments
items.summary: Introduces WebCanvas and Mind2Web-Live, evaluating online task progress through meaningful intermediate states on changing websites.

items.name: Dissecting Adversarial Robustness of Multimodal LM Agents
items.summary: Introduces adversarial tasks on VisualWebArena and an evaluation framework that tracks how manipulated information passes between agent components. The analysis examines vulnerabilities introduced by reflection and tree-search evaluators as well as direct action generation.
items.venue: International Conference on Learning Representations

items.name: WONDERBREAD: A Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Foundation Models on Business Process Management Tasks
items.summary: Introduces WONDERBREAD, a benchmark pairing human WebArena workflow demonstrations with screen recordings, action logs, and written procedures. Six evaluation tasks cover documentation, knowledge transfer, and process improvement beyond end-to-end execution.

items.name: AgentDojo: A Dynamic Environment to Evaluate Prompt Injection Attacks and Defenses for LLM Agents
items.summary: Introduces AgentDojo, an extensible environment of tool-calling tasks over untrusted data that measures prompt-injection attacks, defenses and utility, with 97 tasks and 629 security test cases.

items.name: GUI Action Narrator: Where and When Did That Action Take Place?
items.summary: Introduces Act2Cap and a cursor-guided method for describing GUI actions from video, with temporal and spatial localization challenges.

items.name: VGA: Vision GUI Assistant -- Minimizing Hallucinations through Image-Centric Fine-Tuning
items.summary: Uses image-dependent question-answer data and staged fine-tuning to improve GUI comprehension and reduce unsupported visual answers.
items.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2024

items.name: E-ANT: A Large-Scale Dataset for Efficient Automatic GUI NavigaTion
items.summary: Introduces Chinese-language GUI navigation traces and annotated screenshots collected from human interactions with mini-applications.

items.name: Identifying User Goals from UI Trajectories
items.summary: Defines goal identification from observed UI trajectories and an evaluation method for comparing intent descriptions within the same interface context. Experiments reuse Android and web automation data to compare human and model inference of users’ detailed goals.

items.name: VLM Agents Generate Their Own Memories: Distilling Experience into Embodied Programs of Thought
items.summary: ICAL turns imperfect agent trajectories into reusable strategies and action annotations through reflection and human feedback, with VisualWebArena among its evaluations.

items.name: SpreadsheetBench: Towards Challenging Real World Spreadsheet Manipulation
items.summary: SpreadsheetBench evaluates LLM spreadsheet manipulation with 912 questions from Excel forums and multiple spreadsheet files as test cases for each instruction.

items.name: Read Anywhere Pointed: Layout-aware GUI Screen Reading with Tree-of-Lens Grounding
items.summary: Introduces Screen Point-and-Read and a hierarchical layout approach that interprets screen regions indicated by a user-selected point.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 2024 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing

items.name: Mobile-Bench: An Evaluation Benchmark for LLM-based Mobile Agents
items.summary: Evaluates mobile agents using combined UI and API actions, tasks with varying app scope, and checkpoints for intermediate progress.

items.name: Tree Search for Language Model Agents
items.summary: Applies best-first search to agent actions within interactive web environments, allowing exploration and multistep planning at inference time. WebArena and VisualWebArena experiments examine search behavior and test-time computation.

items.name: CRAB: Cross-environment Agent Benchmark for Multimodal Language Model Agents
items.summary: Introduces CRAB, a framework for cross-environment agent tasks with graph-based evaluation and a benchmark spanning desktop and phone interactions.
items.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2025

items.name: Visual Grounding Methods for Efficient Interaction with Desktop Graphical User Interfaces
items.summary: Compares modular OCR-based and end-to-end methods for locating desktop GUI targets from natural-language instructions.

items.name: Seeing is Believing: Vision-driven Non-crash Functional Bug Detection for Mobile Apps
items.summary: Trident combines exploration, monitoring, and detection agents to identify functional bugs in a mobile app. It reasons over screenshot sequences and interface transitions to construct test oracles, evaluated on 590 non-crash bugs and additional live apps.

items.name: MobileExperts: A Dynamic Tool-Enabled Agent Team in Mobile Devices
items.summary: Introduces MobileExperts, which assembles mobile-agent teams, lets agents explore and formulate tools, and coordinates them through two levels of planning. A benchmark organizes tasks by hierarchical intelligence levels.

items.name: MobileFlow: A Multimodal LLM For Mobile GUI Agent
items.summary: Introduces a mobile GUI model using hybrid visual encoders, mixture-of-experts expansion, and alignment training for multilingual interfaces.

items.name: WorkArena++: Towards Compositional Planning and Reasoning-based Common Knowledge Work Tasks
items.summary: Defines compositional enterprise workflows to evaluate planning and reasoning, with generation of ground-truth interaction traces.
items.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

items.name: UICrit: Enhancing Automated Design Evaluation with a UICritique Dataset
items.summary: Introduces designer-authored mobile UI critiques and quality ratings, studying how targeted examples improve automated design feedback.

items.name: AUITestAgent: Automatic Requirements Oriented GUI Function Testing
items.summary: Automates mobile GUI tests from natural-language requirements, combining action generation with verification based on interaction traces.

items.name: Systematic Categorization, Construction and Evaluation of New Attacks against Multi-modal Mobile GUI Agents
items.summary: Develops a threat taxonomy and evaluation framework for attacks against multimodal mobile GUI agents, with case studies and dataset experiments.

items.name: Spider2-V: How Far Are Multimodal Agents From Automating Data Science and Engineering Workflows?
items.summary: Benchmarks multimodal agents on data-science and engineering workflows involving enterprise applications, code, and GUI operations in real computer environments.
items.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

items.name: Agent-E: From Autonomous Web Navigation to Foundational Design Principles in Agentic Systems
items.summary: Agent-E combines hierarchical web-task control with DOM distillation and observations of interface changes. WebVoyager experiments inform a broader discussion of primitive skills, observation reduction, and self-improvement in agent architecture.

items.name: IDA: Breaking Barriers in No-code UI Automation Through Large Language Models and Human-Centric Design
items.summary: IDA helps business users create web UI automation through guided demonstrations, a semantic programming model, and a teaching-oriented interface. A prototype user study examines automation creation with enterprise applications by users without programming backgrounds.

items.name: AssistantBench: Can Web Agents Solve Realistic and Time-Consuming Tasks?
items.summary: Introduces realistic open-web tasks and the SeePlanAct agent, analyzing the limitations of browsing and retrieval in time-consuming assistant work.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 2024 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing

items.name: OpenHands: An Open Platform for AI Software Developers as Generalist Agents
items.summary: OpenHands is a platform for agents that write code, use a command line and browse the web, with sandboxed execution and support for agent evaluation.

items.name: AMEX: Android Multi-annotation Expo Dataset for Mobile GUI Agents
items.summary: Introduces Android screenshots with element locations, functionality descriptions, and instructions linked to sequences of GUI actions.
items.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2025

items.name: AppWorld: A Controllable World of Apps and People for Benchmarking Interactive Coding Agents
items.summary: Introduces simulated application APIs and state-based task evaluation for interactive coding agents performing everyday digital workflows.

items.name: OfficeBench: Benchmarking Language Agents across Multiple Applications for Office Automation
items.summary: Evaluates language agents on office workflows requiring information integration, long-term planning, and switching between applications.

items.name: MindSearch: Mimicking Human Minds Elicits Deep AI Searcher
items.summary: MindSearch uses a planner and searcher agents to split information requests into subquestions and gather answers across web pages.

items.name: OmniParser for Pure Vision Based GUI Agent
items.summary: Parses screenshots into interactable regions and semantic element descriptions to support visually grounded agent actions.

items.name: Caution for the Environment: Multimodal LLM Agents are Susceptible to Environmental Distractions
items.summary: Measures how irrelevant GUI content affects multimodal agents using a simulated dataset and three perception patterns. The study also examines adversarial environment injection and possible ways to improve instruction faithfulness.

items.name: VisualAgentBench: Towards Large Multimodal Models as Visual Foundation Agents
items.summary: Benchmarks visual agents across GUI, embodied, and design tasks, with training trajectories collected through solvers, agents, and human demonstrations.

items.name: Agent Q: Advanced Reasoning and Learning for Autonomous AI Agents
items.summary: Agent Q combines guided tree search, self-critique and preference-based fine-tuning to train web agents from successful and unsuccessful interactions.

items.name: AppAgent v2: Advanced Agent for Flexible Mobile Interactions
items.summary: Separates exploration and deployment while using a structured application knowledge base and retrieval to guide mobile workflows.

items.name: WebPilot: A Versatile and Autonomous Multi-Agent System for Web Task Execution with Strategic Exploration
items.summary: WebPilot separates global subtask planning from local Monte Carlo tree search during web execution. It continually refines the high-level plan and adapts local search to uncertain transitions and incomplete observations, evaluated on WebArena and MiniWoB++.

items.name: From Grounding to Planning: Benchmarking Bottlenecks in Web Agents
items.summary: Separates web-agent planning and grounding evaluations on Mind2Web to analyze which components limit task performance.

items.name: Agent Workflow Memory
items.summary: Agent Workflow Memory extracts reusable task routines and selectively supplies them to guide later web actions. It studies both offline workflow induction from training examples and online induction from test experience on Mind2Web and WebArena.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning

items.name: Windows Agent Arena: Evaluating Multi-Modal OS Agents at Scale
items.summary: Adapts real-desktop evaluation to Windows applications and supports parallel execution of benchmark tasks.

items.name: PeriGuru: A Peripheral Robotic Mobile App Operation Assistant based on GUI Image Understanding and Prompting with LLM
items.summary: PeriGuru interprets smartphone GUI screenshots with computer vision and uses a language model to decide the next action. A peripheral robotic arm executes the phone interactions, providing an alternative mechanism for operating mobile apps.

items.name: NaviQAte: Functionality-Guided Web Application Navigation
items.summary: Frames web-application exploration as functionality-oriented question answering, generating navigation actions from multimodal context.

items.name: Grounded GUI Understanding for Vision-Based Spatial Intelligent Agent: Exemplified by Extended Reality Apps
items.summary: Orienter detects interactable GUI elements in XR applications by interpreting scene context and revisiting candidate elements through a validation and reflection loop. It addresses open-vocabulary element types and context-dependent interactability.

items.name: EIA: Environmental Injection Attack on Generalist Web Agents for Privacy Leakage
items.summary: Evaluates privacy-directed webpage instruction injection against generalist web agents using PII-related interaction steps from Mind2Web, including attempts to expose specific user information or entire requests.

items.name: The Impact of Element Ordering on LM Agent Performance
items.summary: Studies how the ordering of UI elements in an agent observation affects web and desktop performance. A pixel-based element detector and dimensionality-reduction ordering are evaluated on OmniACT when document hierarchy is unavailable.

items.name: WebQuest: A Benchmark for Multimodal QA on Web Page Sequences
items.summary: Introduces question answering over individual screens, multiple web pages, and navigation traces to test information synthesis across views.

items.name: MobileViews: A Million-scale and Diverse Mobile GUI Dataset
items.summary: Builds mobile screenshot and view-hierarchy pairs through automated application traversal and evaluates their usefulness for GUI grounding.

items.name: MobileVLM: A Vision-Language Model for Better Intra- and Inter-UI Understanding
items.summary: MobileVLM adds two pretraining stages and four UI tasks to learn element detail and relationships between successive screens. Its Mobile3M dataset contains three million Chinese mobile UI pages connected by recorded transition actions.
items.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2024

items.name: Steward: Natural Language Web Automation
items.summary: Introduces Steward, a natural-language browser automation system that repeatedly plans and executes website actions. The paper examines completion detection, state representation, responsiveness, and caching in real-site tasks.

items.name: Synatra: Turning Indirect Knowledge into Direct Demonstrations for Digital Agents at Scale
items.summary: Synatra converts indirect procedural knowledge, including human-oriented tutorials, into direct demonstrations for digital agents. It trains a 7B CodeLlama on 100,000 synthesized demonstrations and evaluates the resulting policy on Mind2Web, MiniWoB++, and WebArena.
items.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

items.name: AXIS: Efficient Human-Agent-Computer Interaction with API-First LLM-Based Agents
items.summary: Introduces AXIS, an API-first application agent that can use UI actions and expand its available APIs through automated application exploration. The work evaluates the approach on Microsoft Word tasks.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 63rd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)

items.name: Inferring Alt-text For UI Icons With Large Language Models During App Development
items.summary: Introduces IconDesc, which generates mobile icon alt-text from partial UI context such as element identifiers, bounds, nearby text and hierarchy. Model evaluation and a user study examine the resulting accessibility descriptions.

items.name: MM1.5: Methods, Analysis & Insights from Multimodal LLM Fine-tuning
items.summary: MM1.5 is a multimodal model family trained with curated data mixtures; its MM1.5-UI variant targets mobile UI understanding.

items.name: Interactive Speculative Planning: Enhance Agent Efficiency through Co-design of System and User Interface
items.summary: Studies agent-system and interface co-design that incorporates user interruptions and intermediate feedback to reduce planning latency.

items.name: DreamStruct: Understanding Slides and User Interfaces via Synthetic Data Generation
items.summary: Generates labeled slides and interface visuals through code to support visual element detection, description, and classification with less manual annotation.

items.name: Dynamic Planning for LLM-based Graphical User Interface Automation
items.summary: Dynamic Planning of Thoughts revises a mobile GUI plan using current environmental feedback and execution history. The study compares this planning strategy with long-dialogue prompting and examines its behavior on unfamiliar tasks and different language-model backbones.
items.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2024

items.name: Multimodal Auto Validation For Self-Refinement in Web Agents
items.summary: Studies text and visual validation for web agents and uses the resulting validator to detect failures and guide workflow self-refinement.

items.name: ExACT: Teaching AI Agents to Explore with Reflective-MCTS and Exploratory Learning
items.summary: ExACT combines reflective tree search with learning from search experience to help web agents explore, assess states and backtrack on VisualWebArena.

items.name: StateAct: Enhancing LLM Base Agents via Self-prompting and State-tracking
items.summary: Maintains explicit task goals and evolving state descriptions to improve base-agent decisions across interactive tasks, including web shopping.

items.name: NNetNav: Unsupervised Learning of Browser Agents Through Environment Interaction in the Wild
items.summary: Generates browser-agent demonstrations through autonomous exploration and retrospective task labeling, pruning trajectories that lack meaningful subtasks.

items.name: Navigating the Digital World as Humans Do: Universal Visual Grounding for GUI Agents
items.summary: Introduces UGround, a visual target-localization model trained with large-scale synthetic references to elements in GUI screenshots.
items.venue: International Conference on Learning Representations

items.name: ST-WebAgentBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Safety and Trustworthiness in Web Agents
items.summary: Evaluates web-task completion under explicit enterprise policies, measuring policy-compliant completion and safety violations separately.

items.name: Agent S: An Open Agentic Framework that Uses Computers Like a Human
items.summary: Combines hierarchical planning, retrieved experience, and a computer interaction interface to execute multistep GUI tasks.
items.venue: International Conference on Learning Representations

items.name: From Interaction to Impact: Towards Safer AI Agents Through Understanding and Evaluating Mobile UI Operation Impacts
items.summary: Develops a taxonomy of mobile-action consequences and annotated interaction data to evaluate whether models recognize impactful or risky UI operations.

items.name: TinyClick: Single-Turn Agent for Empowering GUI Automation
items.summary: Adapts a compact Florence-2 model to map user instructions to screen coordinates using multitask training and augmented data.

items.name: ClickAgent: Enhancing UI Location Capabilities of Autonomous Agents
items.summary: Separates multimodal reasoning and action planning from a dedicated UI localization model, with evaluation on Android devices.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 26th Annual Meeting of the Special Interest Group on Discourse and Dialogue

items.name: Web Agents with World Models: Learning and Leveraging Environment Dynamics in Web Navigation
items.summary: Uses a learned web world model to predict important state changes and compare candidate actions before executing them.

items.name: MobA: Multifaceted Memory-Enhanced Adaptive Planning for Efficient Mobile Task Automation
items.summary: Combines adaptive mobile-task planning, reflection-based recovery, and multiple memory components, evaluated with MobBench and AndroidArena.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 2025 Conference of the Nations of the Americas Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics: Human Language Technologies (System Demonstrations)

items.name: Harnessing Webpage UIs for Text-Rich Visual Understanding
items.summary: Builds MultiUI by generating instructions from webpage accessibility trees and pairing them with screenshots for multimodal training. Evaluation examines web-interface understanding, including VisualWebBench and Mind2Web, and transfer to other text-rich visual tasks.
items.venue: International Conference on Learning Representations

items.name: AgentOccam: A Simple Yet Strong Baseline for LLM-Based Web Agents
items.summary: Studies how simplifying and aligning a web agent's observations and actions with language-model capabilities affects task completion.

items.name: Refusal-Trained LLMs Are Easily Jailbroken As Browser Agents
items.summary: Introduces BrowserART and studies whether chat-model refusal behavior transfers to browser agents carrying out potentially harmful instructions.

items.name: DistRL: An Asynchronous Distributed Reinforcement Learning Framework for On-Device Control Agents
items.summary: Introduces asynchronous distributed reinforcement learning with centralized updates and decentralized interaction collection for device-control agents.
items.venue: International Conference on Learning Representations

items.name: SPA-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for SmartPhone Agent Evaluation
items.summary: Introduces a smartphone-agent benchmark with English and Chinese tasks, real-time Android interaction, and completion and resource-use metrics.
items.venue: International Conference on Learning Representations

items.name: Beyond Browsing: API-Based Web Agents
items.summary: Compares browsing-only, API-only, and hybrid web agents on WebArena, examining how access to application APIs changes task execution alongside browser interaction.
items.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2025

items.name: Large Language Models Empowered Personalized Web Agents
items.summary: PersonalWAB benchmarks personalized web tasks, while PUMA retrieves relevant past web behavior to adapt agents' instruction handling and actions.

items.name: AdvAgent: Controllable Blackbox Red-teaming on Web Agents
items.summary: Introduces a black-box web-agent red-teaming framework that learns adversarial prompts from agent feedback to study security weaknesses.

items.name: MobileSafetyBench: Evaluating Safety of Autonomous Agents in Mobile Device Control
items.summary: Evaluates mobile agents on misuse, side effects, and indirect prompt-injection risks in an Android emulator environment.

items.name: Lightweight Neural App Control
items.summary: LiMAC combines a compact Action Transformer with a fine-tuned vision-language model for Android app control. It uses textual goals and histories of screenshots and UI trees to predict actions, with evaluation on two mobile-control datasets.

items.name: AgentStore: Scalable Integration of Heterogeneous Agents As Specialized Generalist Computer Assistant
items.summary: Introduces a platform that integrates specialized agents under a coordinating MetaAgent for varied computer tasks.

items.name: OSCAR: Operating System Control via State-Aware Reasoning and Re-Planning
items.summary: OSCAR translates user instructions into Python control code while observing screen images and acting through mouse and keyboard operations. A state-machine controller handles errors and replans tasks during execution across desktop and mobile applications.

items.name: Ferret-UI 2: Mastering Universal User Interface Understanding Across Platforms
items.summary: Extends Ferret-UI across device platforms with adaptive visual scaling and synthetic data for referring, grounding, and user-centered UI tasks.

items.name: Infogent: An Agent-Based Framework for Web Information Aggregation
items.summary: Infogent separates navigation, extraction and aggregation for web information gathering, including browser interaction through webpage screenshots.

items.name: VideoWebArena: Evaluating Long Context Multimodal Agents with Video Understanding Web Tasks
items.summary: Evaluates whether web agents can retain procedural skills and factual information from long video tutorials and use them during tasks.
items.venue: International Conference on Learning Representations

items.name: EDGE: Enhanced Grounded GUI Understanding with Enriched Multi-Granularity Synthetic Data
items.summary: Synthesizes GUI training examples at multiple levels of detail from webpages and studies transfer of learned understanding to other interface environments.

items.name: OpenWebVoyager: Building Multimodal Web Agents via Iterative Real-World Exploration, Feedback and Optimization
items.summary: Develops multimodal browser agents through repeated cycles of real-web exploration, trajectory feedback, and policy optimization.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 63rd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)

items.name: Auto-Intent: Automated Intent Discovery and Self-Exploration for Large Language Model Web Agents
items.summary: Discovers compact intents from demonstrations and uses intent predictions to guide a language-model web agent's decisions and exploration.

items.name: OS-ATLAS: A Foundation Action Model for Generalist GUI Agents
items.summary: Combines cross-platform GUI grounding data synthesis with action-model training to study generalization to unfamiliar interfaces.

items.name: Evaluating Cultural and Social Awareness of LLM Web Agents
items.summary: Introduces CASA to assess web agents' responses to cultural and social norms in shopping and forum tasks, including misleading observations.
items.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: NAACL 2025

items.name: From Context to Action: Analysis of the Impact of State Representation and Context on the Generalization of Multi-Turn Web Navigation Agents
items.summary: Analyzes how interaction history and webpage representation affect multiturn web-agent generalization across unfamiliar websites, task categories, and geographic settings.

items.name: AndroidLab: Training and Systematic Benchmarking of Android Autonomous Agents
items.summary: Provides a shared Android action environment, reproducible tasks, and instruction data for training and comparing language and multimodal agents.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 63rd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)

items.name: AutoGLM: Autonomous Foundation Agents for GUIs
items.summary: Presents AutoGLM agents for browser and phone control, separating planning from grounding and training through an evolving interaction curriculum.

items.name: Foundations and Recent Trends in Multimodal Mobile Agents: A Survey
items.summary: Surveys multimodal mobile agents, organizing prompt-based and training-based approaches alongside evaluation benchmarks, supporting technologies, and open challenges in mobile task execution.

items.name: WebRL: Training LLM Web Agents via Self-Evolving Online Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Trains web agents with an evolving task curriculum, outcome supervision, and reinforcement-learning updates intended to manage policy drift.

items.name: Attacking Vision-Language Computer Agents via Pop-ups
items.summary: Tests whether adversarial visual pop-ups divert computer agents from intended tasks in desktop and web benchmark environments.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 63rd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)

items.name: From Novice to Expert: LLM Agent Policy Optimization via Step-wise Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Introduces StepAgent, which compares agent and expert actions to supply intermediate rewards for policy learning, with implicit-reward and inverse-RL variants. Evaluation includes WebShop and Mind2Web alongside non-web tasks.

items.name: Magentic-One: A Generalist Multi-Agent System for Solving Complex Tasks
items.summary: Introduces an orchestrated team of browsing, file, and coding agents with progress tracking and error recovery for general digital tasks.

items.name: GUI Agents with Foundation Models: A Comprehensive Survey
items.summary: Survey of (M)LLM-based GUI agents organized around their datasets and benchmarks, a unified agent framework with a taxonomy, and commercial applications.

items.name: WorkflowLLM: Enhancing Workflow Orchestration Capability of Large Language Models
items.summary: WorkflowLLM builds WorkflowBench from application API workflows and synthetic queries, then trains WorkflowLlama to generate multi-application workflows.

items.name: Is Your LLM Secretly a World Model of the Internet? Model-Based Planning for Web Agents
items.summary: Introduces WebDreamer, which simulates candidate web actions with language-model world models and value estimates before acting.

items.name: The Dawn of GUI Agent: A Preliminary Case Study with Claude 3.5 Computer Use
items.summary: Presents a preliminary study of Claude 3.5 Computer Use across desktop tasks and software, analyzing planning, action, and critique behavior and providing a framework for deploying GUI-automation models.

items.name: Generalist Virtual Agents: A Survey on Autonomous Agents Across Digital Platforms
items.summary: Surveys virtual agents for browsers, applications and operating systems, organizing prior work by task type, observation and action spaces, model strategies and evaluation methods.
