items.name: Right Screen, Wrong Transition: World Models as Verifiers for GUI Agents
items.summary: Presents LGWM, a decoder-free GUI world model that predicts the next screen representation from an action and compares it with the observed state to verify transitions. Its paired diagnostic separates legitimate and hijacked transitions that lead to the same credential screen.

items.name: Can LLMs Fix It Without Code? Toward Automated Verification of No-Code Bug Fixes
items.summary: Tests natural-language no-code fixes through GUI execution in Linux Brave. Scripted fixed/buggy-state gates and issue-specific checkers distinguish fix outcomes from the executor's completion claims.

items.name: SoftwareGym: Scaling Computer-Use Agent Training with Diverse Synthesized Software Environments
items.summary: Introduces SoftwareGym, a pipeline that synthesizes runnable GUI applications and iteratively repairs them using execution checks. It also provides a task benchmark and studies whether training on synthesized application trajectories transfers to other computer-use environments.

items.name: When Charts Deceive Web Agents: A Paired Benchmark for Misleading Visualization-Grounded Tasks
items.summary: Introduces MisVisAgentBench, a paired executable benchmark that changes chart evidence while holding web tasks fixed, to trace how misleading visualizations affect agent decisions and downstream actions.

items.name: CaptchaAgent: Verifiable Visual Reasoning for CAPTCHA Solving
items.summary: Presents CaptchaAgent, which builds an explicit visual representation of objects and relations, refines ambiguous regions, and checks counterfactual consistency before acting on interactive CAPTCHAs.

items.name: Work2Skill: Capturing Human GUI Experience for Reusable Agent Skill Induction
items.summary: Aligns human screen recordings, input events, and accessibility information to derive reusable workflow skills from desktop demonstrations.

items.name: When Faster Decisions Do Not Make Better Agents: An Empirical Study of Jev in Agent Workflows
items.summary: Evaluates Jev as a bounded action selector inside three AndroidWorld agents and two text-based ALFWorld agents, separating decision savings from task success, recovery and resources per delivered outcome.

items.name: ConClick: Element-Wise Contrastive Learning Improves GUI Grounding
items.summary: Analyzes recurring distractor clicks in GUI grounding and introduces ConClick, a contrastive training method built from target–distractor pairs. Its ReClick inference procedure revisits candidate regions and compares competing predictions.

items.name: Web$hell: A Unified Interface for Agentic Web Access
items.summary: Introduces Web$hell, an interface that compiles live pages into persistent information and action objects so agents can gather evidence, navigate websites, and reuse acquired content through shared operations.

items.name: A Baseline Assessment for the Agentic Web Technology Stack
items.summary: Presents MASTIF, a framework for comparing combinations of agent models, protocols, and implementation frameworks on web tasks, with an initial assessment using 300 Mind2Web tasks.

items.name: OpenMobile-2: Building Versatile Mobile Agents with Scalable Environments and App-Native Tools
items.summary: Introduces OpenMobile-2, combining simulated mobile apps, emulator tasks, released training data, and policies that can alternate GUI interaction with app-native tools.

items.name: Latent World Action Model for GUI Agents
items.summary: Replaces future-screenshot generation with a shared latent representation for GUI action selection and action-conditioned transition prediction. An action-aware contrastive objective encourages the transition representation to retain discriminative action-induced changes.

items.name: The Agent Clicks Approve: Injected Page Text Makes Browser Agents Authorize Access the Task Never Named
items.summary: Studies prompt-injected account-access approvals in browser agents and proposes a service-side authority envelope that checks authorization requests against the user task before allowing them to complete.

items.name: From Observations to Authorized Actions: Measuring Source Information in Android Agents
items.summary: Measures source-attribution limits in Android accessibility and separately tests application-history and selected-WebView-object checks for authorizing AppFunctions actions.

items.name: Visible but Not Avoided: State-Dependent Re-Proposal of Rejected Candidates in Catalog-Based LLM Optimization Loops
items.summary: Studies repeated rejected edits while optimizing a screenshot-only GUI agent, contrasting static probes with reached loop states and testing how rejection wording changes subsequent edit proposals.

items.name: A Decade in a Day: Synthesizing Agent-Native Interfaces from Human-Oriented Software Evolution
items.summary: Introduces DeskIF-Bench to study how desktop application interfaces affect agents, and ANIS to synthesize interfaces from installed application capabilities.

items.name: Seg2Click: Learning Pixel-Level Action Masks for GUI Visual Grounding
items.summary: Recasts GUI grounding as predicting a mask of valid click locations from bounding-box supervision, then derives a click point with a deterministic selection rule.

items.name: HyWe: Unifying Search and Operation for Real-World Hybrid Web Tasks
items.summary: Introduces HyWe, which switches between information search and browser operation within one trajectory, alongside a demonstration pipeline and a benchmark of hybrid web tasks.

items.name: EvoWeb: A Benchmark for Coding Agents on Evolving Web Applications
items.summary: Introduces EvoWeb, a benchmark for coding agents that extend web applications through dependent requests; a multimodal web agent checks each version in a live browser.

items.name: Learn from Move: the Next Step for GUI Agents
items.summary: Introduces LatentGUIWorld to test learning interface semantics and dynamics through interaction, and studies finer movement actions with intermediate visual feedback and exploration demonstrations.

items.name: PrivacyGuard: Source-Linked Sanitization and Locally Resolvable PII References for Cloud GUI Agents
items.summary: Introduces PrivacyGuard, which sanitizes source-linked personal information and maintains locally resolvable references across mobile-agent turns to reduce exposure to remote planners.

items.name: Glasseek: A Transparent Recipe for Training and Trustworthy Evaluation of DeepSearch Agents
items.summary: Introduces Glasseek, a framework for deep-search agents that explore the open web, with trajectory construction, training across context compression, and a test-set leakage audit.

items.name: BrowseSafe++: Benchmarking Prompt Injection Detection Across Web Contexts, Languages, and Browser Views
items.summary: Extends BrowseSafe with paired attacked and clean webpages in several representations, and studies text and screenshot detectors plus feedback-adapted prompt injections.

items.name: Adaptive-Group Process Rewards for GUI Agents
items.summary: Groups GUI trajectories by subgoal and combines action-level and group-level assessments into intermediate rewards for training agents with sparse task outcomes.

items.name: MHVF: Training-Free GUI Grounding via Verification-Guided Multi-Hypothesis Search
items.summary: Introduces MHVF, a training-free grounding method that explores several candidate screen regions, verifies them in local views, and uses those checks to guide further search.

items.name: Interaction-as-a-Judge
items.summary: Uses computer-use agents to interact with generated applications, studying whether interaction improves preference judging, requirement checks, and feedback for application generation.

items.name: Learning How to Remember: Memory Modality Selection for GUI Agents
items.summary: Introduces SwitchMem, which chooses a textual or visual representation of retrieved experience at each GUI interaction step.

items.name: WorkRover: Scaling Long-Horizon Cowork Agent Training Via Recursive Environment Evolution
items.summary: Synthesizes resettable workspaces with files, application observations and skills; repairs environment incompatibilities and trains long-task agents using verifier-linked turn credit.

items.name: Towards Safe Autonomy for Computer Use
items.summary: Presents SA-CUA, separating trusted and untrusted visual content using accessibility-derived masking rules and a controlled channel for verifying information before endorsement.

items.name: Reading Right, Acting Wrong: Diagnosing Decision Failures of System One Models in Agent Loops
items.summary: Pairs factual probes with next-action choices on frozen agent traces, including Mind2Web, to diagnose reading-decision gaps without closed-loop execution.

items.name: Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents
items.summary: Introduces CarryOn, which maintains evidence-linked task objects and remaining-work context across history compression, with evaluations on desktop tasks and web research.

items.name: GroundGUI: GUI Grounding by High-Quality Data and Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Introduces ScreenRef screenshot grounding data and a training sequence from supervised learning through teacher-guided distillation to reinforcement learning for GroundGUI-8B.

items.name: CLASHarness: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Conflict in Computer Use via a Controllable and Verifiable Generation Pipeline
items.summary: Introduces CLASHarness, generating verifiable computer-use tasks with conflicting agent reports, shared-state constraints, and coordination requirements to evaluate conflict detection and resolution.

items.name: Seeing, Maintaining, and Learning: The Evolution of Multimodal Agent Memory
items.summary: Surveys multimodal memory using representation and management axes, distinguishing fixed-policy updates from policy evolution and comparing GUI memory evaluation with other modalities.

items.name: MMA-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Multimodal Agent Safety Evaluation
items.summary: Builds trajectory-guided visual-injection tests for web, desktop and mobile observations, separating target-matching action predictions from broader semantic compromise.

items.name: Teaching Agents in their Own Style: Blackbox Teacher Distillation for Web Agents
items.summary: Introduces WebKD, which repairs failed student web-agent trajectories with minimal teacher edits and trains on corrections that preserve the student's reasoning style.

items.name: How GUI Agents Fail: GraceBench for Execution Stability Diagnosis
items.summary: Introduces GraceBench, using application transition graphs and recorded interaction evidence to diagnose deviations, loops, and recovery that final task-success scores can hide.

items.name: Task-State Governance: A Virtual Machine for Verifiable and Recoverable GUI Agent Execution
items.summary: Presents TaskVM, an interface for specifying desired and preserved application state, checking agent actions, and exposing whether changes can be reversed or compensated.

items.name: Why Generate a Click? Plug-in Decision Heads for Web Agents
items.summary: Adds decision heads to a frozen vision-language generator for selecting web actions and targets, with a confidence gate that falls back to text generation.

items.name: STP-GUI: Spatially-Aware Token Pruning for Efficient Web-GUI Agents
items.summary: Introduces STP-GUI, which selects spatially coherent screenshot windows conditioned on the instruction to reduce visual tokens while retaining useful interface structure.

items.name: Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience
items.summary: Extends computer-use policies to game control through synthetic training environments and richer keyboard and pointer actions. Its evaluation concerns games.

items.name: Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language Agents
items.summary: Introduces CoPE, which trains language agents to forecast later actions from earlier histories during RL; WebShop is one of five evaluation benchmarks.

items.name: MAI-Gym: An Open All-in-One Platform for GUI Agent Evaluation and RL Training across Mobile and Computer Environments
items.summary: Unifies GUI evaluation, trajectory collection, environment synthesis, and online reinforcement learning across mobile, computer, and web tasks.

items.name: OpenGCUA: Toward a Fully Open Stack for Generalist Computer Use
items.summary: Introduces an open generalist computer-use stack combining visual and programmatic interaction, with model-controlled observation and task-state decisions.

items.name: OS-Helix: Unifying GUI Interaction and Code Execution in Native Computer-Using Agents
items.summary: Trains native computer-use models to coordinate GUI actions and code execution using hybrid demonstrations and online reinforcement learning.

items.name: LEASH: Uncertainty-Aware Weak-to-Strong Escalation and Oversight for Computer-Use Agents
items.summary: Uses weak-agent uncertainty to decide when to escalate to a stronger model and monitor its subsequent task execution.

items.name: ECHOES: Seeing Beyond the Current Image via Recursive History Compression and Privileged On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: ECHOES learns recursive textual task memory through privileged screenshot-history distillation and GRPO, then predicts GUI actions from the current screenshot and memory.

items.name: Lean4AgenticRL: Advancing Agentic RL with Verifiable Multi-level Process Rewards
items.summary: Lean4AgenticRL formalizes workflow stages and process rewards for reinforcement learning on software engineering and terminal-use tasks, an adjacent setting for interface agents.

items.name: Don't Retrain, Remix: Adaptation of Web Agents using Mixture Hypernetworks
items.summary: WebMix uses a scout-produced interface manual to route mixtures of source-trained LoRA adapters for web agents, adapting to target interfaces without target-time gradient updates.

items.name: Not All Graphs Are Maps: A Task-Agnostic Exploration Framework for Mobile GUI Navigation
items.summary: TAG-Nav supplies Android GUI agents with destination and route memory distilled from offline app exploration. DestBench measures arrival at a reference pre-action screen, separately from downstream task execution.

items.name: What It Is, Not What It Says: Securing Agentic Browsing Interactions with Web Semantics
items.summary: Intact records webpage element provenance and capabilities, isolates planning per element, and uses a browser harness to constrain actions and request consent for third-party interactions.

items.name: PersonaCUABench: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agents Serving Diverse Personas
items.summary: PersonaCUABench varies simulated user requests and clarification dialogue over fixed web tasks, comparing task completion with requirement handling and persona-agent satisfaction ratings.

items.name: Adaptation of Computer Use Agents to New Software with User Manuals
items.summary: MAGE retrieves software-manual sections into fixed execution plans and generates setup/main task-plan pairs whose GUI rollouts support application-specific policy adaptation with round-based GRPO.

items.name: MobileJailBench: Red Queen Jailbreak Benchmarking for Mobile Agents
items.summary: MobileJailBench evaluates mobile-agent jailbreaks in a browser-based Android-like simulator, combining feedback-driven attack evolution, separately admitted task expansions and evidence-grounded outcome adjudication.

items.name: MobileInject: Evaluating Reasoning-to-Action Security of MLLM-Based Mobile Agents under Cross-Modal Consistency Injection
items.summary: MobileInject evaluates visual/textual observation injection in stateful Android workflows using resettable emulators, benign/adversarial state oracles and trace-based diagnosis of emitted rationales and actions.

items.name: Web Agent Agentic Reinforcement Learning Decision Model Under Multi-Cost and Failure Risk
items.summary: Proposes constrained reinforcement learning for web agents that weighs request costs, latency and failure risk across multi-step website tasks.

items.name: BlenderWorld: Benchmarking Visual Agents for 3D Creation from Real-World References
items.summary: Benchmarks agents creating editable Blender projects through shell, Python and MCP tools, judging delivered scenes with multi-view renders, task-specific rubrics and visual-quality ratings.

items.name: SPIDES: Information-Flow Control for Browser Agents
items.summary: SPIDES propagates HTML integrity and confidentiality labels into agent context and mediates browser actions with information-flow policies and approval gates, evaluated in the labeled MicroNet ecosystem.

items.name: Beyond Next-Screen Prediction: The Decision Value of GUI World Models
items.summary: Separates next-screen prediction from action evaluation in GUI lookahead and trains Direct Action Ranking on reference actions, comparing prediction-augmented scoring under matched offline supervision.

items.name: fxBench: Evaluating and Understanding Formula Suggestions in Spreadsheets
items.summary: Introduces fxBench, a benchmark of spreadsheet formula suggestions, and examines context selection, intent understanding and formula writing for editing assistance.

items.name: From Seeing to Reporting: A Theory of Reliable Visual Set Generation in Vision-Language Models
items.summary: FSR models visual reporting and gives inference-time procedures for frozen vision-language models, including screen parsing and GUI target selection.

items.name: Step-Aligned Script Generation with Verification and Recovery for Web Automation Testing
items.summary: Presents TESSARA, which turns natural-language web test intent into Playwright scripts, linking each browser interaction to selector evidence, outcomes, and repair history.

items.name: CUA-Lite: An Open Platform for Computer Use Agents
items.summary: CUA-Lite unifies environment interfaces, supervised data formats and per-model harnesses for evaluation, reinforcement learning and supervised fine-tuning across desktop, browser and mobile tasks.

items.name: Focused Omni-Modal GUI Agents
items.summary: FocusGUI learns step-specific weights over screenshot, audio, video and interaction-context channels, injecting a compact residual into a frozen decoder without pruning its inputs.

items.name: VeriCUA: Learning Proactive Verification for Reliable GUI Agent Rewards
items.summary: VeriCUA trains a Judge to select verification checks and stopping decisions while a frozen Probe inspects the post-task GUI. Single-attempt reinforcement learning balances verdict correctness and Probe use.

items.name: ScopeMem: Latent Memory That Learns Where to Revise Frozen GUI Agents
items.summary: ScopeMem conditions latent-memory prefixes on a frozen GUI agent's initial action and trains them to correct errors while preserving correct decisions. Its evaluation separates action repairs from harmful revisions.

items.name: Tandem: Serving Hybrid Linear-Attention GUI Agents on Mobile NPUs
items.summary: Tandem serves hybrid GUI-agent models on Android NPUs using divergence-point state checkpoints, rollback-aware speculative decoding and idle power release between request bursts.

items.name: Comparing Computer Use Behavior Across Multiple Levels of Abstraction
items.summary: MAP annotates computer-use traces at linked operation, function/consequence, method and goal levels, then compares human and agent workflows through sequence, pattern and effort metrics.

items.name: Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis
items.summary: WildAWM synthesizes resettable GUI/MCP/CLI environments and cross-interface tasks, using execution-based checks of solvability, difficulty and verifier consistency before supervised and reinforcement learning.

items.name: CUA-Recovery: Benchmarking Error Recovery in Long-Horizon Computer-Use Agents
items.summary: CUA-Recovery benchmarks error detection and recovery across desktop applications, using agent failures to create test states and training trajectories.

items.name: Lost in Recovery: Demystifying Recovery Behavior of Computer-Use Agents via Goal-Oriented Action Replay
items.summary: ReTrace evaluates how keyboard-and-mouse computer-use agents recover from injected errors by replaying actions and comparing downstream outcomes.

items.name: Evolving Agent Interfaces
items.summary: Agent S4 uses task trajectories to evolve interfaces and usage guidance for a computer-use agent, selecting changes through validation tasks.

items.name: InterWebCoder: Learning Interactive Webpage Generation from Executable Tests via Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: InterWebCoder trains models to generate interactive webpage code using recorded interactions, executable tests and repair feedback, an adjacent web interface task.

items.name: Steering Black-Box Large Language Model Agents with Pitfall Anticipation World Model
items.summary: PAWM predicts likely multi-step pitfalls and selectively guides black-box agents; its evaluations include a web-agent benchmark.

items.name: Who Verifies the Agent's Success Claim? Self-Report Leakage in GUI-Agent Completion Judging
items.summary: Studies how GUI agents' success claims affect completion judgments and builds a claim-blind auditor that checks reports against recorded traces.

items.name: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
items.summary: PAPAV is a capability framework and survey comparing computer-use agents with physical agents through perception, anticipation, planning, action and verification.

items.name: Deep Search in Real-World Web Environments
items.summary: OpenDS-World benchmarks multi-step research on the live open Web, requiring agents to search, interact with browsers and combine evidence across sources.

items.name: MPIDetector: Detecting Multi-modal Prompt Injection via LLM-based Reasoning
items.summary: MPIDetector uses few-shot prompts to detect text and visual prompt injections, with environmental web-agent injections included in its evaluation.

items.name: Diagnosing Personalization Failures in Mobile GUI Agents
items.summary: PrefDiag-Bench diagnoses when and how user preferences should affect sequential mobile GUI agent actions, using staged probes and user context.

items.name: HiSTEVE 1.0: Harnessing Human-Interface VLA Agents for Open-World Games
items.summary: HiSTEVE uses a hierarchical planner and a vision-only keyboard-and-mouse controller for Minecraft tasks that include GUI and non-GUI interactions.

items.name: PointerBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Fine-Grained GUI Grounding
items.summary: POINTERBENCH is a diagnostic GUI grounding suite covering spreadsheet sub-elements, document characters and targets across professional applications.

items.name: Subgoal-aware Memory Graph for GUI Agent
items.summary: Proposes a subgoal-aware memory graph that turns past mobile GUI agent trajectories into reusable evidence for decisions across tasks.

items.name: AgentVQA: A Unified Benchmark for Agentic Visual Understanding
items.summary: AgentVQA is an offline visual question-answering benchmark across five agent domains, including web agents and questions involving UI element location.

items.name: Understanding Tool-Mediated Interaction Failures in Agentic GUI Software: An Empirical Study
items.summary: Malva catalogs failures that make GUI agents' tool-mediated view diverge from the live interface; MalvaGuard checks related tool contracts before deployment.

items.name: Reuse, Rewrite, or Reject: Evidence-Constrained Trace Reuse for Repeated Mobile GUI Control
items.summary: Proposes graph-text templates that let mobile GUI agents reuse, adapt, or discard steps from earlier executions based on the current instruction and UI state.

items.name: Correct Answers, Closed Gates: SolveBind for GUI Agents at the Verification Barrier
items.summary: Introduces SolveBind, a GUI-agent framework that decomposes verification tasks and uses runtime evidence to guide interactions with protected websites and applications.

items.name: WaitLens: Temporal VLM-Based Adaptive Waiting for Industrial GUI Testing Agents
items.summary: Introduces WaitLens, a vision-language model trained on GUI loading trajectories to decide when testing agents can stop waiting for an interface to load.

items.name: IGG: A Benchmark for Interactive GUI Grounding under Visibility Constraints
items.summary: Introduces Interactive GUI Grounding (IGG), a benchmark that tests whether agents can reveal hidden interface targets through interaction before clicking them.

items.name: SkillShift-Bench: Benchmarking Skill Learning under Environment Evolution for Web Agents
items.summary: Introduces SkillShift-Bench to evaluate how web agents reuse learned skills when task context, visual perception, or execution conditions change across web systems.

items.name: Build or Adopt? Custom-Built vs. General-Purpose LLM Agent Harnesses for Automotive GUI Testing
items.summary: Compares a custom harness with general-purpose LLM agent harnesses for GUI testing of Android-based vehicle interfaces and tasks in public apps.

items.name: PreView: Enhancing GUI Grounding with Preprocessed Views and Cues
items.summary: Introduces PreView, a screenshot preprocessor that adds cropped views and candidate cues to help existing GUI grounding models identify controls for clicks.

items.name: AndroidFlux: Evaluating and Reward Modeling Failure Recovery Capabilities in Mobile Use Multimodal Agents
items.summary: Introduces AndroidFlux, a mobile-agent failure-recovery benchmark that restores trajectories to error checkpoints, plus a reward-modeling benchmark and offline RL dataset.

items.name: HobbyLM: A Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Model Family on a Hobby Budget
items.summary: Describes HobbyLM, a small model family whose post-trained variants include a computer-use agent and an on-device macOS computer-use adapter.

items.name: AgentProofBench: Benchmarking Reusable Verifiers for Web Agents
items.summary: Introduces AgentProofBench, a benchmark linking tests of reusable web-agent verification rules to subsequent execution from saved web states.

items.name: Harness-Model Collaboration for Long-Horizon Continual Learning
items.summary: Introduces HaMo, a continual-learning framework for web agents that retrieves strategy cards from past workflows and updates model parameters to reuse them.

items.name: iPrefBench: A User-Centric Benchmark for Personalized Mobile Use Agents
items.summary: Introduces iPrefBench, an iOS benchmark for mobile agents that tests when they infer missing user preferences from activity history and when they ask the user.

items.name: GUIFlow: Temporal Redundancy-Aware Incremental Inference for GUI Agents
items.summary: Introduces GUIFlow, an incremental inference framework that reuses visual, language, and action computation across successive GUI-agent steps.

items.name: Co-Design Bench: Multimodal Collaborative Coding Evaluation for Agentic Models
items.summary: Introduces Co-Design Bench to evaluate coding agents that revise applications from multimodal user requests, including UI changes assessed with browser evidence.

items.name: Chart the Invisible: Interactive Perception for Hidden-Target Exploration in GUI Agents
items.summary: Introduces Hagasu, a scrollable-region perception model that helps GUI agents decide where to swipe to reveal hidden targets, especially on mobile screens.

items.name: Back to Basics: A Skill-Centric Approach to Generalist Web Agents
items.summary: Introduces MiniWeb for skill-labeled browser tasks, MiniWebGen for generating training trajectories, and MiniWebAgent for composing learned skills into web workflows.

items.name: When to Intervene? An Empirical Study of Errors and Self-Recovery in LLM Agents
items.summary: Introduces ReInBench, annotated computer-use and web-agent error traces, and ReCoF, a method for predicting whether an agent will recover without intervention.

items.name: Right Click, Wrong Box: Grading GUI Grounding by What a Click Does
items.summary: Proposes grading GUI grounding clicks by their executed outcomes and audits box-based scores on live web applications and ScreenSpot-v2 screenshots.

items.name: AdaGround: Token-Normalized Adaptive Zooming with Verifier-in-the-Loop Refinement for GUI Grounding
items.summary: Introduces AdaGround, a training-free GUI grounding method that adjusts screenshot zoom to target size and uses a click verifier to refine or reject predictions.

items.name: GUI-JEPA: Candidate-Conditioned JEPA Latents as a Fast Action Policy for Mobile GUI Agents
items.summary: Introduces GUI-JEPA, a mobile GUI policy that scores candidate actions from screenshot latents in a batched pass without decoding action text.

items.name: Learning to Look Beyond Screens: Transferable Visual Observation from GUI Grounding
items.summary: Introduces LBS, a vision-language model trained with GUI grounding trajectories and crop-and-inspect decisions to study transfer of active visual observation.

items.name: From Interaction to Capability: Task Advancement as State and Supervision for GUI Agents
items.summary: Introduces Task Advancement Memory (TAM) for long GUI workflows, tracking task progress across applications and learning reusable operations from interactions with local results.

items.name: WebAnything: From the Wild Web to Scalable Agent Environments
items.summary: Introduces WebAnything, a framework that reconstructs reusable, resettable website environments from real URLs for web-agent training and evaluation.

items.name: AgentHeal: Evaluating Goal-Preserving Resource Recovery of Web Agents under Access Barriers
items.summary: Introduces AgentHeal, a benchmark of whether web agents detect access barriers, find legitimate alternative sources, and preserve the user's original goal.

items.name: Where to Learn and How Far to Roll Out: Efficient Adaptive Training for GUI Agents
items.summary: Introduces a two-stage GUI-agent RL framework that selects uncertain action checkpoints and expands rollout length as training progresses.

items.name: Online Dense Reinforcement Learning with Planning-Grounding Agent for UI Navigation on Live IOS Apps
items.summary: Introduces online RL training for agents navigating live iOS apps, separating planning from UI grounding and using step-level and task-completion rewards.

items.name: What Does "Now" Mean to Your Computer-Use Agent? Stale Screenshots, Page Loads, and Which Check to Run Before a Click
items.summary: Studies clicks made from stale screenshots on web pages and provides a benchmark generator and pre-click checks for pages that change during loading.

items.name: InterA11y: Interactive Web Accessibility Error Detection with LLM Agents
items.summary: Introduces InterA11y, a web accessibility evaluation system that guides LLM agents with rubrics and tools for inspecting and operating pages.

items.name: DynaRev: Benchmarking Web Agents under Dynamic Goal Revision
items.summary: Introduces DynaRev, a benchmark of 181 web-agent tasks whose goals change during execution, with trajectory-based measures of correctness, responsiveness, and efficiency.

items.name: EnvOS: Auditing Computer-Use Agents When the World Moves On : Phenomenon-Based Task Construction, Certification, and Evidence-Based Evaluation
items.summary: Introduces EnvOS, a framework for constructing and auditing changing computer-use environments, including checks of task changes, solvability, grading, and run evidence.

items.name: VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents
items.summary: Introduces VeriCUA, a cross-platform task verifier that gathers evidence through GUI or code checks to assess computer-use agent completion.

items.name: Mage-VL-Cowork: A Full Training Recipe to Learn Hybrid Computer Use From Evolved Harnesses
items.summary: Introduces Mage-VL-Cowork, a computer-use agent trained for GUI, code, and terminal actions, with Mage-CUA-Forge generating desktop and web tasks for training.

items.name: AgentShield: Fortifying Web Applications Against AI Agents and Agentic Browsers
items.summary: Evaluates agentic browsers against web anti-bot defenses and introduces AgentShield, a behavioral fingerprinting framework for distinguishing agents from people.

items.name: ANGLER: Verifier-Grounded Benchmarking with an Adaptive Attacker for Web Agents
items.summary: Introduces REEF, a website benchmark with state-based attack verification, and ANGLER, which adapts attack lures using outcomes from web-agent rollouts.

items.name: Cross-Interface Authorization for AI Computer-Use Agents
items.summary: Presents a profile-bounded authorization protocol for computer-use agents working through GUIs, APIs, scripts, and other routes, with route-bound tickets and commit-time checks.

items.name: Hybrid Computer Use: A Unified Programmatic, Semantic, and Visual Interface for General Agents
items.summary: Introduces Hybrid Computer Use (HCU), a desktop agent interface combining code, accessibility data, and GUI actions, with AX diffs reporting action effects.

items.name: PatchScout: Thematic Web Data Collection via Information Foraging
items.summary: Introduces PatchScout, a multi-agent method for collecting thematic documents from the live web by deciding when to explore a new information region.

items.name: MemU-Bench: Benchmarking GUI Agents on Long-Horizon User Interactions
items.summary: Introduces MemU-Bench for mobile GUI tasks that depend on past user interactions, alongside AppMem, a training-free memory framework for retrieving app-specific context.

items.name: LADS: Lease-Aware Delivery Scheduling of Tool Results for Language Model Agents
items.summary: Introduces LADS, a scheduler for returning browser-action results to web agents, using cache leases and estimated resumption delay to reduce workflow latency.

items.name: When 200 OK Is Not an Answer: Silent Fetch Failures in Agentic Web Content Acquisition
items.summary: Studies silent failures in web content fetched by static and rendered-browser clients, and evaluates checks for whether HTTP 200 pages contain usable content.

items.name: UI-UG 2: Advancing Mobile UI Understanding and Generation with Fine-Grained Supervision and Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Introduces UI-UG 2, a mobile UI model trained for component understanding, GUI grounding, and structured interface generation with render-aware RL.

items.name: MAPLE: A Multimodal Mobile Agent with Playbook-Learned Experience
items.summary: Introduces MAPLE, a training-free multi-agent framework that shares step-level experience while navigating mobile GUIs and updates prompts during execution.

items.name: Interface Quilt: Modifying Applications with Computer Use Agents and Generative UI
items.summary: Introduces Interface Quilt, which uses computer-use agents and generated UI overlays to modify how existing applications look and behave without source access.

items.name: MAGAR: Multimodal Agents for GUI-Based 3D Mechanical Assembly and Minimal Rework
items.summary: Introduces MAGAR-Bench for GUI-based 3D mechanical assembly decisions and recovery, and MAGAR, a selective correction method for assembly outputs and actions.

items.name: Coati: Host-Grounded Execution for Installable Mobile GUI Agents
items.summary: Introduces Coati, an installable Android GUI agent that checks action outcomes with phone-side evidence, stores per-app procedures, and routes simpler steps to a fast executor.

items.name: From Local Skills to Long-Horizon Web Tasks: Progressive Skill Exploration for LLM Web Agents
items.summary: Introduces SCOPE, a training method for long web-agent tasks that discovers local skills from rollouts, composes them into chains, and expands them using failure experience.

items.name: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
items.summary: Introduces CUA-Master, a computer-use training framework that mines workflows from instructional videos and turns them into synthesized tasks and trajectories.

items.name: ScienceCUA: Resource-to-Skill Construction and Execution-Guided Skill Evolution for Scientific Computer Use Agents
items.summary: Introduces ScienceCUA, which turns scientific software documentation into reusable agent skills and revises them using execution feedback, with two audited evaluation variants.

items.name: WebHarbor: Docking Real Websites for Evolving GUI Agent Environments
items.summary: Introduces WebHarbor, a suite of 153 executable website environments and 3,518 tasks for evaluating and training GUI web agents on interactive workflows.

items.name: What Is This Memory Useful For? Measuring Task-Conditioned Utility in Long-Term Agent Memory
items.summary: Introduces task-conditioned measurements and a dataset for assessing whether stored agent memories help later tasks, using factual-recall tasks built from web-agent memories.

items.name: Computer-Use Agents Gain Little Benefit from a World Model When Conditioned on Tutorials
items.summary: RAG-PolicyJudge selects computer-use actions proposed with task-specific tutorials; the study compares its decisions with and without world-model rollouts.

items.name: Interpretable Early Termination of Web Navigation Agents via Closed Sequential Pattern Mining
items.summary: Applies sequential pattern mining to MiniWoB++ web-agent traces, producing reviewable failure signatures and an early-termination policy to reduce token use.

items.name: Voluntary Servitude: Weaponized Safety Warning Mechanisms for Controlling AI Agents
items.summary: Studies fabricated hazard warnings in reviews that steer agents’ choices without explicit commands, including transfer to browser agents, and tests a corroboration requirement.

items.name: JHiMA-WebRL: A Joint Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Long-Horizon Web Tasks
items.summary: Introduces JHiMA-WebRL, which jointly trains a task decomposer and GUI actor with hierarchical RL for long-horizon web tasks in WebArena.

items.name: Can LLM Agents Learn to Test? Maintaining Scoped Experience as Testing Evidence for Mobile GUI Testing
items.summary: AdaptiTest specifies scoped, revalidated memory for an LLM-based mobile GUI tester to reuse routes and locators across read-only Android test workflows.

items.name: Securing Web Agents with the Compile-Then-Execute Paradigm
items.summary: Baya compiles a web task into a program using a Trusted Website API before viewing live content, limiting how webpage prompt injections can alter agent control flow.

items.name: MKD2World: A Typed Spatial MarkDown World Model For Web Agents
items.summary: Introduces MKD2World, a desktop web world model that represents interface elements in Typed Spatial Markdown and predicts post-action states, supported by AtomBlock-WebUI annotations.

items.name: Visual Token Routing: Learning to keep tokens that matter
items.summary: Introduces Visual Token Routing (VTR), which selects visual tokens from current and earlier screenshots to reduce computer-use agent inference cost while retaining action-relevant information.

items.name: GUI Grounding for Computer-Use Agents: A Survey
items.summary: A survey of GUI grounding organizes methods by learning, inference, and target representation, and reviews datasets, benchmarks, metrics, and inference costs.
items.venue: Preprints.org

items.name: WebOlympus: An Open Platform for Web Agents on Live Websites
items.summary: Presents WebOlympus, an open platform that runs web agents on live websites from a few lines of code or a Chrome extension, with a safety monitor that blocks harmful actions through human or model checks.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 2024 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing: System Demonstrations

items.name: Do GUI Grounders Truly Understand UI Elements?
items.summary: A desktop GUI grounding benchmark tests whether models identify the same element across varied descriptions; a diagnosis agent generates difficult instructions using model feedback.
items.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EACL 2026

items.name: GUI testing for mobile applications: objectives, approaches and challenges
items.summary: A systematic review of mobile app GUI testing examines objectives, methods, evaluation metrics, and research challenges across 75 studies published from 2010 to 2020.
items.venue: 12th Asia-Pacific Symposium on Internetware

items.name: 30 Years of Automated GUI Testing: A Bibliometric Analysis
items.summary: A bibliometric review traces automated GUI testing research from 1990 to 2020, examining publication growth, citation patterns, collaboration, and emerging mobile testing topics.
items.venue: Communications in Computer and Information Science

items.name: Operator System Card
items.summary: The Operator system card describes a browser agent trained to act from screenshots and details evaluations, risk policies, user confirmations, and monitoring for web tasks.
items.venue: OpenAI

items.name: Robotic Process Automation: Contemporary themes and challenges
items.summary: A structured review of robotic process automation examines software bots that mimic user actions and identifies research themes and challenges for organizational use.
items.venue: Computers in Industry

items.name: Towards Ethical and Personalized Web Navigation Agents: A Framework for User-Aligned Task Execution
items.summary: A web navigation framework uses user-specific task representations and interactive reasoning to adapt agent workflows to preferences, with task success and satisfaction as evaluation measures.
items.venue: Proceedings of the Eighteenth ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining

items.name: FDC-Ground: Improving GRPO for GUI Grounding via Exponential Rewards and Fact-Aligned Pruning
items.summary: FDC-Ground trains GUI element location models with a distance-based reward and completion pruning; a 7B model is evaluated on ScreenSpot and ScreenSpot-v2.
items.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

items.name: Ringer: Web Automation by Demonstration
items.summary: Introduces Ringer, which converts demonstrated webpage interactions into scripts combining actions, target selectors, and waiting conditions. It evaluates replay robustness on tasks recorded from real websites.
items.venue: OOPSLA 2016

items.name: Visual Grounding for User Interfaces
items.summary: Proposes LVG, which detects and grounds the UI element named by a free-form command in an Android screenshot, using layout-guided contrastive learning and synthetic referring expressions generated from Rico screens.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 2024 Conference of the North American Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics: Human Language Technologies (Volume 6: Industry Track)

items.name: AssistEditor: Multi-Agent Collaboration for GUI Workflow Automation in Video Creation
items.summary: AssistEditor coordinates GUI agents to turn video requirements and uploaded materials into storyboards and editing actions in professional desktop software.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 32nd ACM International Conference on Multimedia

items.name: SUGILITE: Creating Multimodal Smartphone Automation by Demonstration
items.summary: Introduces SUGILITE, which combines spoken instructions, demonstrated Android actions, and UI hierarchies to generate reusable automation scripts. Its interface includes context checking and repairs for unfamiliar situations and changing app interfaces.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 2017 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems

items.name: Look Before You Leap: Context-Sensitive GUI Grounding for Boosting Automated Extended Reality (XR) Testing
items.summary: Orienter detects interactive elements in 3D XR interfaces using app context and iterative reflection, then evaluates detection and guided testing on Steam app images.
items.venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Software Engineering

items.name: Look Where You’re Told: Instruction-Consistent Attention for GUI Grounding
items.summary: Attention Cycle-Consistency trains GUI element grounding with semantic and spatial alignment constraints, while removing its auxiliary components at inference.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 4th Workshop on Advances in Language and Vision Research (ALVR)

items.name: MemAgent: A cache-inspired framework for augmenting conversational Web Agents with task-specific information
items.summary: MemAgent adds a cache for task-specific information to conversational web agents, separating information gathering from execution across 150 web tasks.
items.venue: From Objects to Agents 2025

items.name: Automating GUI-based Software Testing with GPT-3
items.summary: A GPT-3-based GUI testing method interprets natural-language test cases, tracks current interface elements in prompts, and navigates desktop and mobile applications.
items.venue: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Software Testing, Verification and Validation Workshops (ICSTW)

items.name: LongHorizonUI: A Unified Framework for Robust long-horizon Task Automation of GUI Agent
items.summary: Training-free GUI agent that indexes screen elements via icon detection and OCR, checks each step with multi-level reflection and recovers by fallback clicks or rollback; introduces LongGUIBench, tasks over 15 steps.
items.venue: International Conference on Learning Representations 2026 (ICLR 2026)

items.name: World of Bits: An Open-Domain Platform for Web-Based Agents
items.summary: Introduces World of Bits, a web-task platform combining human demonstrations, keyboard and mouse actions, and cached HTTP traffic for repeatable task environments. It evaluates agents trained through behavioral cloning and reinforcement learning.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 34th International Conference on Machine Learning

items.name: Computer Agent Arena: Toward Human-Centric Evaluation and Analysis of Computer-Use Agents
items.summary: Crowdsourced arena where users set tasks on cloud Ubuntu or Windows desktops, watch two anonymous computer-use agents attempt them side by side and vote; reports 2,201 votes over 12 agents.
items.venue: International Conference on Learning Representations 2026 (ICLR 2026)

items.name: Learning to Contextualize Web Pages for Enhanced Decision Making by LLM Agents
items.summary: Trains a separate language model to rewrite lengthy web page observations into focused descriptions for LLM web agents, keeping training targets that let several LLMs predict the correct next action.
items.venue: International Conference on Learning Representations 2025 (ICLR 2025)

items.name: GUI Testing Using Computer Vision
items.summary: Presents visual GUI test scripts that use images to specify actions and expected screen feedback. Recording both input events and screenshots can generate tests from demonstrations, supporting unit, regression, and test-driven workflows.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 28th International Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI '10)

items.name: PLOW: A Collaborative Task Learning Agent
items.summary: Describes PLOW, which learns executable web-task models from a session combining demonstrations, natural-language explanations, and dialogue. Browser instrumentation connects user actions with DOM structure to support task generalization.
items.venue: Twenty-Second AAAI National Conference on Artificial Intelligence

items.name: Are CAPTCHAs Still Bot-hard? Generalized Visual CAPTCHA Solving with Agentic Vision Language Model
items.summary: Presents Halligan, a VLM agent that abstracts visual CAPTCHAs into frames, elements and keypoints and solves each as a search problem through generated interaction code, tested on 2,600 challenges of 26 types.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 34th USENIX Security Symposium

items.name: OpenWebAgent: An Open Toolkit to Enable Web Agents on Large Language Models
items.summary: Presents OpenWebAgent, a web automation toolkit that pairs a Chrome plugin with an HTML parser and an action generation module, in a modular framework where developers plug in LLMs or LMMs.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 62nd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 3: System Demonstrations)

items.name: Guardian: A Runtime Framework for LLM-Based UI Exploration
items.summary: Guardian guides LLM-driven mobile app testing by narrowing available UI actions and replanning after invalidated actions; it is evaluated on 58 tasks from 23 apps.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 33rd ACM SIGSOFT International Symposium on Software Testing and Analysis

items.name: Test-Agent: A Multimodal App Automation Testing Framework Based on the Large Language Model
items.summary: Test-Agent uses an LLM, screenshots, and interface structure to generate and execute mobile app test actions from natural-language instructions across platforms.
items.venue: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Digital Twins and Parallel Intelligence (DTPI)

items.name: Focus Like a Human: Efficient GUI Grounding via Coarse-to-Fine Visual Attention and Parallel Verification
items.summary: FastFocus grounds GUI targets by proposing regions from low-resolution views and checking candidates with parallel high-resolution zooms; it is evaluated on ScreenSpot-Pro.
items.venue: Proceedings of the Thirty-Fifth International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence

items.name: Trace2Ground: Scenario, Disambiguation, and Relation Traces for Web GUI Grounding
items.summary: Trace2Ground builds a web GUI grounding dataset from HTML/DOM elements and simulated traces, testing scenario, duplicate-label, and relational instructions.
items.venue: Proceedings of the Second Workshop for REsearch on Agent Language Models (REALM 2026)

items.name: Kite: Building Conversational Bots from Mobile Apps
items.summary: Derives task graphs from demonstrated Android app interactions and layers a conversational question-answer interface over those graphs. The evaluation examines task-model extraction and developer use of the resulting bot templates.
items.venue: The 16th Annual International Conference on Mobile Systems, Applications, and Services

items.name: UI-Hawk: Unleashing the Screen Stream Understanding for Mobile GUI Agents
items.summary: Mobile GUI agent whose history-aware visual encoder reads earlier screenshots with the current one, trained by a curriculum from grounding, referring, screen QA and summarization to navigation; adds the FunUI benchmark.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 2025 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing

items.name: Rousillon: Scraping Distributed Hierarchical Web Data
items.summary: Introduces Rousillon, which generalizes a demonstration of collecting one hierarchical data row into a browser-automation program that traverses related pages. The paper develops relation-selection and generalization methods and evaluates users building such scripts.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 31st Annual ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology

items.name: INREACT: An Inspire-Then-Reinforce Training Framework For Multimodal GUI Agent
items.summary: InReAct trains a multimodal GUI agent with staged curriculum learning and outcome-based reinforcement learning for pixel-level grounding and navigation.
items.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2025

items.name: SkillTracer: Structural Failure Attribution and Refinement of Agentic Skills in Long-Horizon Web Tasks
items.summary: SkillTracer maps web agent skills to inspectable plan graphs, uses interaction traces to locate failures, and refines reusable skills across long tasks and episodes.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining V.2

items.name: Sikuli: Using GUI screenshots for search and automation
items.summary: Introduces screenshot-based GUI search and visual scripting, using image patterns to locate interface targets and direct mouse and keyboard events. It evaluates screenshot queries and demonstrates automation and interactive-help tasks.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 22nd Annual ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology (UIST '09)

items.name: In-Context Teacher–Student Guidance for Open-Weight Browser Agents
items.summary: Training-free protocol that turns a teacher model's offline reasoning traces into prompt guidance for open-weight browser agents; on MiniWoB++ it lifts solved student-task pairs from 208 to 271 across ten students.
items.venue: Anais do XIV Symposium on Knowledge Discovery, Mining and Learning (KDMiLe 2026)

items.name: RealWeb: A Benchmark for Universal Instruction Following in Realistic Web Services Navigation
items.summary: Introduces RealWeb, a Chinese benchmark of 11,739 instructions on 40 real websites with annotated screenshots and slot trees, plus a baseline that detects page regions, parses instructions and acts on the pages.
items.venue: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Web Services (ICWS)

items.name: Robotic Process Automation and Artificial Intelligence in Industry 4.0 – A Literature review
items.summary: A literature review examines how robotic process automation tools combine with AI for organizational workflows in Industry 4.0, including information extraction and process optimization.
items.venue: Procedia Computer Science

items.name: Rico: A Mobile App Dataset for Building Data-Driven Design Applications
items.summary: Introduces Rico, collecting Android interface designs and interaction traces through crowdsourced use followed by automated exploration. The paper demonstrates UI-layout retrieval using learned representations and describes visual, textual, structural, and interaction data.
items.venue: UIST '17: Proceedings of the 30th Annual ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology

items.name: WinSpot: GUI Grounding Benchmark with Multimodal Large Language Models
items.summary: Introduces WinSpot, a Windows GUI grounding benchmark of 5,000 manually validated coordinate-instruction pairs, built by having multimodal LLMs label raw desktop screenshots without HTML or accessibility trees.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 63rd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 2: Short Papers)

items.name: APPINITE: A Multi-Modal Interface for Specifying Data Descriptions in Programming by Demonstration Using Natural Language Instructions
items.summary: Introduces APPINITE, a conversational interface for specifying the intended targets of demonstrated Android actions. It constructs semantic UI representations and uses an on-screen overlay to preview and refine executable data descriptions.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 2018 IEEE Symposium on Visual Languages and Human-Centric Computing

items.name: GUI-SAGE: Enhancing GUI Automation with Self-Explanatory Learning
items.summary: GUI-SAGE generates reasoning conditioned on known actions and weights policy updates using confidence and reward signals. Its experiments use AndroidControl and GUIOdyssey data and separately evaluate interactive AndroidWorld tasks.
items.venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)

items.name: Eager: Programming Repetitive Tasks by Example
items.summary: Describes Eager, which detects repeated HyperCard interactions, generalizes them into loops, and previews predicted actions by highlighting interface objects. Users can then ask it to execute the inferred repetitive task.
items.venue: Proceedings of CHI '91

items.name: UINav: A Practical Approach to Train On-Device Automation Agents
items.summary: Trains small Android automation agents from demonstrations, using macro actions with status checks, demonstration augmentation, and a referee model that predicts task completion to guide further demonstrations.
items.venue: Proceedings of the 2024 Conference of the North American Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics: Human Language Technologies (Volume 6: Industry Track)

items.name: Koala: Capture, Share, Automate, Personalize Business Processes on the Web
items.summary: Introduces Koala, a collaborative web automation system that records browser interactions as editable pseudo-natural-language scripts. Scripts are shared through a wiki and instantiated with personal or corporate data for reuse by other users.
items.venue: CHI 2007 Proceedings

items.name: Grounding Multimodal Large Language Model in GUI World
items.summary: Trains a 0.4B SAM-initialized GUI grounding model on 0.5M auto-collected web screenshots with 35M element annotations, then links it to a Qwen-VL planner through a position token for MiniWob, AITW and Mind2Web.
items.venue: International Conference on Learning Representations 2025 (ICLR 2025)

items.name: A Survey on Benchmarks of LLM-based GUI Agents
items.summary: Surveys LLM-based GUI agent benchmarks in three task tiers (grounding and QA, multi-step navigation, open-world environments), comparing their datasets, environments and metrics, and outlines open evaluation gaps.
items.venue: TechRxiv

items.name: AgentBreaker: Evaluating Context-Aware Indirect Prompt Injection Risks in Modern Web Agents
items.summary: AgentBreaker generates page-specific prompt injections in HTML elements to test web agents, then evaluates attacks and defenses on 60 webpages from Online-Mind2Web.
items.venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Software Engineering

items.name: AdapAction: Adaptive Target Action Backdoor Attack against GUI Agents
items.summary: Backdoor attack that fine-tunes GUI agents on teacher-written malicious trajectories, so a trigger makes the agent choose a harmful action fitting the current screen and instruction; tested on AitZ and AndroidControl.
items.venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition

items.name: Task Automation Intelligent Agents: A Review
items.summary: A literature review examines mobile phone task automation agents, including programming by demonstration and usability heuristics for recurring user tasks.
items.venue: Future Internet

items.name: LLM Agents: A Survey
items.summary: A survey organizes LLM agents by planning, memory, tool use, coordination, evaluation, and safety, covering computer-use agents among more than two hundred works.
items.venue: Preprints.org

items.name: GUI-Based Software Testing: An Automated Approach Using GPT-4 and Selenium WebDriver
items.summary: A web GUI testing method combines GPT-4 with Selenium WebDriver and compares its branch coverage with random monkey testing on a web calculator.
items.venue: 2023 38th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering Workshops (ASEW)
